hf.title: TeleChat to Xing4: Advancing Frontier Agentic Models on Domestic Chips and Frameworks
hf.abstract: We present Xing 4, a series of large language models that extends the TeleChat lineage through coordinated advances in model architecture and training infrastructure on Ascend. This report describes the design principles and systems engineering behind the series, spanning architecture selection, large-scale pretraining, and reasoning and agentic post-training. We study how sparse activation, attention design, model depth and width, and speculative decoding balance model capacity with computation, memory access, and execution overhead. Our pretraining infrastructure builds on MindSpore HyperParallel, combining topology-aware hybrid sharding, efficient distributed optimizer execution, and coordinated management of long-sequence workloads and activation memory. CPU affinity and core isolation further reduce host scheduling interference. Together, these mechanisms support the pretraining of a 285B-parameter model on 8,192 Ascend 910C cards, providing a concrete setting for the architectural and systems studies. For post-training, we introduce TeleGym, a unified agent execution platform that connects execution, evaluation, and trajectory construction to policy optimization. Disaggregated asynchronous execution, bounded oversampling, and partial rollout accommodate heterogeneous task durations while preserving trajectory continuity across policy updates. Together, these advances establish an Ascend-oriented training foundation for the continued development of Xing 4 across model scales and increasingly demanding reasoning and agent workloads.
hf.titleZh: TeleChat 到 Xing4：在国产芯片与框架上推进前沿 Agentic 模型
hf.summaryZh: 在昇腾（Ascend）平台上打通模型架构与训练基础设施，构建 Xing4 系列大模型。架构侧研究稀疏激活、注意力设计、模型深度与宽度、投机解码，以平衡容量与算力、访存及执行开销；预训练侧基于 MindSpore HyperParallel 实现拓扑感知混合切分、分布式优化器执行与长序列激活内存协同管理，并用 CPU 亲和性与核隔离降低调度干扰，在 8192 张昇腾 910C 上完成 285B 参数模型预训练。后训练侧提出 TeleGym 统一 Agent 执行平台，将执行、评估与轨迹构建连接到策略优化，通过分离式异步执行、有界过采样与部分 rollout 适配异构任务时长，并在策略更新间保持轨迹连续性。
hf.reason: 国产芯片上旗舰级模型技术报告，覆盖预训练与 Agentic 后训练

hf.title: AscendGYM: A Cost-Aware Kernel Optimization Benchmark for Real-World Workloads on Ascend NPUs
hf.abstract: Kernel optimization is essential for efficient large language model (LLM) training and inference on Ascend NPUs. Existing Ascend kernel benchmarks primarily focus on kernel generation, with less emphasis on the ability of agents to optimize existing implementations under input configurations drawn from real workloads. To address this requirement, we introduce AscendGYM, a benchmark whose initial suite comprises 48 kernels across three difficulty levels. Each kernel is paired with test cases whose data types and tensor shapes are collected from real-world training and inference tasks. Consequently, performance improvements on AscendGYM map directly to the corresponding workloads. In terms of usability, two evaluation modes are supported in AscendGYM: model evaluation and model-harness evaluation. The kernel optimization capabilities of both trained models and custom agents are allowed to be measured. It provides a complete execution environment that closely reproduces how Ascend kernels are invoked in practical pipelines. For model evaluation, it additionally includes a built-in harness equipped with search orchestration and experience accumulation. Finally, we propose a new metric, the Speedup-Token Score (STS), which quantifies performance gains relative to token cost. By jointly considering speedup and cost, STS enables the assessment of practical kernel optimization capability of a model or harness under an acceptable budget. AscendGYM is available at https://github.com/SLAI-AITP/AscendGYM.
hf.titleZh: AscendGYM：面向 Ascend NPU 真实工作负载的成本感知内核优化基准
hf.summaryZh: 现有 Ascend 内核基准多聚焦内核生成，较少考察智能体在真实负载输入配置下优化已有实现的能力。AscendGYM 首版包含 48 个内核、分三档难度，每个内核配套的测试用例，其数据类型与张量形状均采集自真实训练与推理任务，因此基准上的性能提升可直接映射到对应负载。它支持模型评测与 model-harness 评测两种模式，提供复现实际流水线内核调用方式的完整执行环境，内置带搜索编排与经验积累的 harness，并提出 Speedup-Token Score（STS）指标，将加速比与 token 成本联合考量。
hf.reason: Ascend 内核优化基准，属代码智能与 Agent 评测，方法系统

hf.title: Weight-Space Programming Doesn't Need Transformers
hf.abstract: Standard neural architectures such as the Transformer were chosen because they train well with gradient descent and run fast on GPUs. In weight-space programming, a large language model (LLM) writes target weights by hand without gradient-based training, so those reasons no longer apply. Should we keep the Transformer? Given minimal guidance, ten labeled examples, and a sandbox, mainly on multiple-choice questions, we task three frontier LLMs with either generating the weights of a fixed architecture or designing the architecture themselves. When free to design, all three compile plain-text facts into a sparse table queried by a fixed procedure, reaching up to 54.4% test accuracy. An LLM-designed model achieves higher test accuracy than the most accurate released Transformer that the same LLM wrote while using about 1,800x fewer parameters. Without gradients, they choose a table, in which the LLM can state what each weight means and can find and rewrite a wrong one. Each wrong answer points to one row, and removing a row changes about one other answer. From this, we propose an associative-memory-based model up to 17x faster on GPUs than a same-sized Transformer. We also test pretrained weights, other benchmarks, and tasks where models generate answers. Pretrained LLMs remain more accurate; the claim concerns which structure to build when writing weights.
hf.titleZh: 权重空间编程无需 Transformer
hf.summaryZh: 在「权重空间编程」中，LLM 直接手写目标权重、不经梯度训练，Transformer 因可训练性与 GPU 效率而被选中的理由不再成立。研究给三个前沿 LLM 极少提示、十个标注样本与沙盒，让其生成固定架构权重或自行设计架构;放开设计时三者都把纯文本事实编译成稀疏表并用固定过程查询，测试准确率达 54.4%，同一 LLM 设计的模型以约 1800 倍更少参数超过它自己写的最准 Transformer。据此提出的联想记忆模型在 GPU 上比同规模 Transformer 快 17 倍，权重可解释、可按行定位改写;但预训练 LLM 准确率仍更高，结论限定于手写权重时该选何种结构。
hf.reason: 权重空间编程与高效新架构，命中架构与效率方向

hf.title: Multi-Branch Transformer
hf.abstract: Transformer language models are commonly scaled by making their blocks wider or stacking them deeper. In this work, we explore a complementary path: branching, the parallel composition of full Transformer blocks. We introduce the Multi-Branch Transformer (MBT), which processes the input through shared initial layers, executes independently parameterized branches of sequential blocks in parallel, and fuses their outputs before shared final layers. At comparable training compute, we study three MBT variants: Wide-Shallow preserves block width, Narrow-Deep preserves sequential depth, and Balanced interpolates between them. In controlled pretraining experiments at four mixture-of-experts scales (0.8B to 2.1B total parameters), 2-branch Wide-Shallow MBTs consistently outperform sequential Transformers under matched parameter and training-compute budgets. Balanced MBTs improve further and retain comparable quality as the number of branches increases. To improve inference efficiency at long contexts, we introduce Joint-KV, which constructs a shared KV cache from branch representations at each depth. Our final recipe combines Balanced MBTs with Joint-KV, supported by an inference engine that exploits branch grouping and shared-cache reuse. Fitted scaling curves indicate that standard Transformers require up to 1.26x as much training body compute to match our final models' validation loss. These models reduce full-model KV-cache storage by up to 34% and deliver up to 51.4% higher decoding throughput on a single H200 GPU. Ablation studies show that branching yields gains beyond changes in width and depth, enables an effective KV-sharing strategy (Joint-KV), remains robust across fusion functions, and performs best in the middle layers. These findings show that branching offers a practical path for scaling language models toward both better modeling quality and faster inference.
hf.titleZh: 多分支 Transformer
hf.summaryZh: 探索宽度与深度之外的第三条扩展轴——分支：多分支 Transformer（MBT）先用共享的初始层处理输入，再并行执行若干条参数独立的连续 block 分支，最后经共享的末端层融合输出。在 0.8B 至 2.1B 总参数的四个 MoE 规模上做受控预训练，2 分支 Wide-Shallow 变体在参数量与训练算力对齐下稳定优于串行 Transformer，Balanced 变体进一步提升且随分支数增加保持质量。面向长上下文推理提出的 Joint-KV 在每个深度上用分支表示构建共享 KV cache，配合利用分支分组与缓存复用的推理引擎，使全模型 KV cache 存储最多降低 34%，单张 H200 上解码吞吐最高提升 51.4%；拟合的 scaling 曲线显示标准 Transformer 需多至 1.26 倍的训练主干算力才能达到同等验证损失。
hf.reason: 新架构扩展轴＋预训练与推理效率系统性验证，直接命中LLM架构方向

hf.title: ForceHarness: Turning Force into Action and Physics for Frozen Frontier Models
hf.abstract: Frontier multimodal models can now control robots zero-shot from images, yet many manipulation tasks depend on contact forces that images cannot show. Bringing force to an API-only frozen model raises two challenges. First, contact evolves much faster than an API model can decide, so the system must close the loop on force beneath the model. Second, a frozen model cannot interpret raw force streams, so force must be returned in a form the model can reason about. Therefore, we present ForceHarness, a harness that lets frozen models use force without demonstrations or finetuning. After calibrating hand force from a wrist sensor or joint torques alone, ForceHarness addresses the first challenge with self-terminating force primitives that regulate force on their own and return at a contact event. To address the second challenge, a physics translation layer turns each force trace into physical quantities with uncertainty as the tool result. To evaluate ForceHarness against expert force controllers and learned policies under identical conditions, we also build HiddenPhys, a seven-task MuJoCo benchmark with hidden physical variables. On a real arm without a wrist force sensor, ForceHarness raises the zero-shot success rate of GPT-6 Astra from 3.3% to 90.0%. In simulation, it adds 17.5 percentage points on the public ForceBench suite and 34.3 percentage points on HiddenPhys, surpassing force-aware policies trained on demonstrations on both benchmarks and matching hand-written expert controllers on HiddenPhys. Ablations further show that smaller models make significantly better decisions when given physical quantities rather than raw force values.
hf.titleZh: ForceHarness:把力转化为动作与物理量，让冻结的前沿模型用上力觉
hf.summaryZh: 前沿多模态模型已能零样本看图控制机器人，但许多操作任务依赖图像无法呈现的接触力;纯 API 的冻结模型既跟不上接触力的演化速度，也读不懂原始力信号。ForceHarness在模型之下用可自终止的力原语闭环调节接触力、在接触事件处返回，并用物理翻译层把力轨迹转成带不确定性的物理量作为工具结果交给模型推理，无需示教与微调。在无腕部力传感器的真实机械臂上，它把GPT-6 Astra的零样本成功率从3.3%提升到90.0%，仿真中在ForceBench与HiddenPhys上分别提升17.5与34.3个百分点，超过示教训练的力感知策略并追平手写专家控制器;消融显示小模型拿到物理量后决策显著更好。
hf.reason: 冻结VLM的机器人harness与力觉接口，直击具身智能体方向

hf.title: Breath-Dx: A Time Series Classification Benchmark for Disease Screening with eNose
hf.abstract: Electronic nose (eNose) technology offers a portable, non-invasive route for disease screening via exhaled breath analysis. However, progress in the field is hindered by the lack of systematic benchmarks that compare machine learning methods under realistic conditions, particularly sensor drift, a known but rarely quantified failure mode. Most existing studies rely on small, private datasets with inconsistent protocols, rendering results non-comparable and slowing progress. We introduce Breath-Dx, the first comprehensive benchmark of time series classification methods for breath-based disease screening. Our work leverages the Scent of Health (S-OH) dataset, the largest public clinical eNose collection to date, comprising 1,234 patients across nine diagnostic groups, each providing a 17-channel multivariate time series with explicit temporal train/test splits that account for sensor drift. We systematically evaluate 10 methods spanning four families: feature-based tabular learners, convolution-based models, graph-based, and time series architectures. All methods degrade significantly under temporal validation (0.05-0.12 AUC drop compared to random cross-validation), confirming that drift embeds a strong temporal signal. Under this realistic evaluation, the best methods achieve ROC AUC of 0.74-0.76 for some lung conditions, though others remain near chance. Recurrent architectures show the most consistent performance across diseases, while specialized time series methods achieve the highest peak results. Demographic confounders matter: breath signals provide independent diagnostic value for some conditions but add little beyond age for others. We release the S-OH dataset, all temporal splits, evaluation protocols, and code to enable reproducible research and accelerate progress in clinical breathomics.
hf.titleZh: Breath-Dx：一个面向电子鼻疾病筛查的时间序列分类基准
hf.summaryZh: 针对呼气式电子鼻疾病筛查缺乏系统性基准、现有研究多依赖小型私有数据且难以量化传感器漂移的问题，构建了首个该类时间序列分类基准Breath-Dx。基于目前最大的公开临床电子鼻数据集S-OH（1,234名患者、九个诊断组、每例17通道多变量时间序列），提供显式考虑传感器漂移的时间序划分，并系统评测特征型表格学习器、卷积模型、图模型与时间序列架构四类共10种方法。结果显示时间序验证下所有方法AUC普遍下降0.05–0.12，部分肺部疾病最佳AUC为0.74–0.76，循环架构跨病种最稳定，人口学混杂因素对部分疾病影响显著；数据集、划分与代码全部开源。
hf.reason: 电子鼻疾病筛查基准，属生物医药垂直应用，与LLM无关

hf.title: Self-Improvement Memory Enables Continual Recursive Self-Improvement
hf.abstract: Harness optimization is often studied with a fixed policy model and benchmark. When either changes, the optimizer must decide which parts of an evolved harness to reuse or revise, but the harness alone may not explain why earlier edits were made or how they performed. In this work, we study Continual Recursive Self-Improvement (CRSI), a setting for continuing existing harness-optimization methods across compatible benchmarks or policy models. We propose Self-Improvement Memory (SIM) for the harness optimizer, rather than the task-solving policy. SIM groups edits by recurring harness problem and records their rationale, predicted and observed outcomes, and evaluation context. New attempts extend this history as optimization continues. In our experiments across four domains, SIM achieves higher final scores than harness-only and root-cause-only continuation in cross-dataset and pairwise cross-model comparisons. Across ten independent source runs in coding, paired continuations with SIM improve final scores by an average of 2.36 points over harness-only continuation (p=0.003).
hf.titleZh: 自我改进记忆实现持续递归式自我改进
hf.summaryZh: 针对harness优化在策略模型或基准更换后难以判断哪些演化改动可复用的问题，提出持续递归自我改进(CRSI)设定，并为harness优化器(而非任务求解策略)引入自我改进记忆(SIM):按反复出现的harness问题归组历史编辑，记录其动机、预测与实测结果及评测上下文，新尝试在此基础上持续累积。在四个领域的跨数据集与成对跨模型比较中，最终得分高于仅用harness与仅用根因的续跑方式;编码域十个独立源运行上，SIM成对续跑较harness-only平均提升2.36分(p=0.003)。该机制为Agent scaffold的长期自演化提供了可迁移的记忆载体。
hf.reason: Agent harness自我演化加记忆机制，直接命中自进化与Agent方向

hf.title: FastFrames: Video Generation at Interactive Latency
hf.abstract: Autoregressive video diffusion models generate frames based on new observations and inputs, making them a promising medium for interactive visual experiences. However, existing models are orders of magnitude too slow for fluid interaction. This paper introduces FastFrames, a family of fast autoregressive video diffusion models that achieves interactive latency without compromising quality. We profile the inference pipeline of state-of-the-art models and find that operations often treated as fixed implementation details, such as VAE decoding and KV cache updates, in fact account for over half of end-to-end inference latency. We challenge the assumption that these components are indispensable and replace them with lightweight alternatives. Our 1.3B variant runs at 36 ms per frame, or 28 responses per second (RPS), on a single B200 GPU while matching the generation quality of a state-of-the-art model that is nearly 8x slower. Our 14B variant runs at 45 ms per frame, or 22 RPS, on an 8x B200 GPU node and yields significantly better visual quality and realism. We show that FastFrames enables real-time interaction in applications such as camera-conditioned and physics-conditioned video generation.
hf.titleZh: FastFrames：交互延迟级别的视频生成
hf.summaryZh: 自回归视频扩散模型具备交互式视觉体验的潜力，但现有推理速度慢了几个数量级。FastFrames 通过剖析推理管线发现，VAE 解码与 KV cache 更新等被视为固定实现细节的操作占端到端延迟一半以上，于是将其替换为轻量替代方案。1.3B 变体在单张 B200 上达到每帧 36ms（28 RPS），质量与慢近 8 倍的 SOTA 模型相当；14B 变体在 8×B200 节点上达每帧 45ms（22 RPS），视觉质量与真实感显著更优，并支持相机条件与物理条件的实时交互生成。
hf.reason: 视频扩散生成与加速，属低分的视觉生成方向

hf.title: TCP4D: A Unified Tool-Center-Point Tracking and Generation Model for Robot Manipulation
hf.abstract: Robot manipulation videos provide a rich visual experience, yet recovering robot action and gripper-state annotations from RGB observations still remains challenging. Using the embodiment-agnostic tool-center-point (TCP) pose as the action space, we present TCP4D, a unified model in which a shared 4D scene representation both tracks observed TCP motion and generates future TCP trajectories. Given a monocular video and initial 2D TCP queries, the tracker directly recovers metric TCP poses in SE(3) and gripper states alongside scene geometry and camera parameters. The generator samples local features from the same 4D representation along the recovered TCP tracks, then combines them with robot observations and language instructions to predict future TCP states. Our new cross-embodiment augmentation pipeline converts existing RGB videos into demonstrations for alternative embodiments by retargeting the recovered motion and synthesizing the corresponding observations, without recorded source-robot states. Experiments show that the tracker achieves absolute trajectory errors of 7.60 and 16.07 mm on DROID and RoboLab and adapts to a new embodiment with only ten demonstrations. The generator achieves 69.19% mean success on RoboTwin and outperforms well-established policy models on two real-world tasks, while joint training on source and augmented demonstrations improves target-robot success by 41.5% over augmented-only training.
hf.titleZh: TCP4D：面向机器人操作的统一工具中心点跟踪与生成模型
hf.summaryZh: 从单目RGB视频恢复机器人动作与夹爪状态标注仍具挑战。TCP4D以与本体无关的工具中心点（TCP）位姿作为动作空间，用统一的4D场景表示同时跟踪观测到的TCP运动并生成未来TCP轨迹：跟踪器在SE(3)下回归米制位姿、夹爪状态以及场景几何和相机参数，生成器沿轨迹采样同一4D表示的特征，并结合语言指令预测未来TCP状态。配套的跨本体增广流水线通过重定向恢复的运动并合成观测，把RGB视频转成其他本体的演示数据。跟踪在DROID与RoboLab上绝对轨迹误差分别为7.60与16.07 mm，仅需十条演示即可适配新本体；生成器在RoboTwin上平均成功率69.19%，在两个真机任务上优于现有策略模型，源数据与增广数据联合训练比仅用增广数据提升目标机器人成功率41.5%。
hf.reason: TCP动作空间的视频标注与跨本体增广，策略数据方向扎实工作

hf.title: Heave-Ho: Decentralized Long-Horizon Multi-Humanoid Collaboration
hf.abstract: Collaboration promises to extend humanoid capabilities beyond what individual robots can achieve. However, realizing this potential requires coordinated whole-body interactions, coherent long-horizon planning, and precise synchronization across robots. We introduce Heave-Ho, a decentralized framework for long-horizon collaborative multi-humanoid loco-manipulation. At the low level, we develop a multi-agent post-training framework that adapts a humanoid foundation tracking model to physically coupled interactions between humanoids, enabling coordinated decentralized control from local observations alone. At the high level, we train a vision-language planner and design a speech-based leader-follower coordination mechanism to synchronize decentralized execution without network communication. Trained with two identical humanoids, our system scales to teams of up to ten robots and generalizes to heterogeneous teams without retraining. To benchmark these capabilities, we introduce HH-Bench, comprising 12 tasks involving teams of 2 to 10 humanoids, including heterogeneous teams. Systematic evaluations show that Heave-Ho consistently outperforms baseline methods, while real-world experiments demonstrate robust decentralized collaboration across challenging tasks.
hf.titleZh: Heave-Ho:去中心化长时程多类人机器人协作
hf.summaryZh: 多类人机器人协作受限于全身物理耦合、长时程规划与跨机同步。Heave-Ho在低层用多智能体后训练把类人基础跟踪模型适配到机器人间的物理耦合交互，仅凭本地观测实现去中心化协同控制;高层训练视觉语言规划器，并用语音式领队-跟随机制在无网络通信下同步执行。仅用两台同构机器人训练即可扩展到十台规模，并零样本泛化到异构团队;配套 HH-Bench 含 12 项 2 至 10 台机器人的任务，系统评测与真机实验均优于基线。
hf.reason: 多类人协作的 VLA 规划与去中心化控制，但偏底层本体控制

hf.title: VideoNexus: Video Perception Beyond the Reasoning Context
hf.abstract: Understanding long videos requires locating evidence, resolving visual details, and integrating observations into an answer. Even when relevant evidence is present, performing these operations within long, dense visual sequences burdens both perception and reasoning. Video agents enable selective inspection, but returning frames to the planner still accumulates visual information in its reasoning context. Delegating perception reduces this burden, yet sparse sampling can miss decisive details, and per-frame descriptions can preserve context growth. We introduce VideoNexus, a training-free framework that separates detailed video perception from evidence-driven planning and reasoning. The planner controls where to inspect, what to resolve, and how densely to sample. Perception sub-agents process native audio-video in independent contexts and return compact, temporally grounded evidence for iterative search and verification. Using Gemini 3.8 Flash for both planning and perception, VideoNexus achieves 88.6% accuracy on full LVBench, exceeding same-backbone static ingestion and built-in agentic processing by 3.6 and 1.1 points, respectively, at 44% of the latter's measured API cost. A paired LVBench subset ablation shows lower planner input and higher accuracy. With Kimi K3 as the shared backbone, VideoNexus improves over the official Video-GAIA ReAct harness by 8.5 points in our evaluation. These results support compact evidence exchange for combining detailed observation with efficient planning and reasoning.
hf.titleZh: VideoNexus:超越推理上下文的视频感知
hf.summaryZh: 长视频理解需要在密集视觉序列中定位证据、解析细节并整合成答案，但把帧持续回传给规划器会让视觉信息在推理上下文中不断累积。VideoNexus是一个免训练框架，把细粒度视频感知与证据驱动的规划推理分离:规划器决定检查哪里、解析什么、采样密度多大，感知子代理在独立上下文中处理原生音视频，只回传紧凑且带时间定位的证据，供迭代搜索与验证。以Gemini 3.8 Flash同时承担规划与感知，在完整LVBench上达到88.6%，比同骨干的静态摄入与内置代理式处理分别高3.6与1.1个百分点，而API成本仅为后者的44%;换用Kimi K3时，相对官方Video-GAIA ReAct harness提升8.5个百分点。结果表明紧凑证据交换可在保留细节观察的同时支撑高效规划与推理，适用于长视频问答与视频Agent场景。
hf.reason: 视频Agent感知与规划解耦，属多模态理解与Agent交叉的扎实工作

hf.title: Regularized Score Centering
hf.abstract: Asynchronous reinforcement learning increases training throughput, but data from stale policies and numerical mismatch between training and inference can destabilize learning. To stabilize off-policy learning, score centering (SC) removes the effect of reward baselines on the expected update. Our gradient diagnostics show less extreme gradients with SC than with importance sampling (IS), but SC can still fail when the learner moves far from the behavior policy that generated the data. To limit this policy mismatch, we introduce Regularized Score Centering (RSC), which adds a reverse Kullback-Leibler (KL) penalty to encourage the learner's next-token distribution to stay close to the behavior policy's next-token distribution. RSC works with or without truncated importance sampling (TIS), which caps token importance weights. Our theoretical analysis supports this approach, showing that KL regularization improves convergence guarantees. We evaluate dense and mixture-of-experts models on mathematical reasoning and agentic tasks, including online shopping, tool use, games, and fully asynchronous software engineering. RSC with TIS substantially improves sample efficiency across all agentic benchmarks, attaining higher training rewards with the same number of sampled responses. In final evaluations, it achieves top performance across all six agentic tasks, improving by 14.3% on AppWorld and reaching 9.9 times the strongest baseline's score on BabyAI.
hf.titleZh: 正则化分数中心化
hf.summaryZh: 异步RL提高训练吞吐，但陈旧策略数据与训练/推理数值不一致会破坏学习稳定性。本文先从梯度诊断出发，说明分数中心化(SC)能消除奖励基线对期望更新的影响、梯度比重要性采样(IS)更温和，但当学习器远离行为策略时仍会失效;为此提出正则化分数中心化(RSC)，加入反向KL惩罚约束下一 token 分布贴近行为策略，可与截断重要性采样(TIS)配合，并从理论上证明KL正则改善收敛性。在数学推理与在线购物、工具调用、游戏、全异步软件工程等agentic任务上，对dense与MoE模型评测，RSC+TIS在各benchmark上显著提升样本效率，六个agentic任务的最终评测均取得最优，AppWorld提升14.3%,BabyAI达到最强基线的9.9倍。
hf.reason: 异步off-policy RL稳定性新方法，直接命中后训练方向

hf.title: π^4: A Foundation Model for 4D Scene Geometry and Motion
hf.abstract: π^4 is a unified foundation model for 4D scene perception. From diverse, uncalibrated RGB observations in the wild---a single image, an unordered collection, or a video sequence---it recovers dense geometry, camera poses, and metric scale, together with 2D/3D point tracks and moving-object masks for multi-image inputs. It couples a geometry branch with a geometry-conditioned motion branch, which predicts image-space correspondences that are lifted into 3D using reconstructed target-view geometry. Across diverse benchmarks, π^4 achieves the best overall average rank in geometry evaluation, alongside competitive performance in single- and multiview 2D/3D point tracking and moving-object segmentation. With a shared backbone, the full geometry-and-motion system contains approximately 0.5B parameters---less than half the size of most baselines. It produces joint reconstructions and tracks in one forward pass, including large-scale scenes with thousands of input images despite training with contexts of at most 64 views. We further present the data and training recipe underlying these capabilities, together with empirical studies of key design choices. Code and models are available at https://github.com/yyfz/Pi4.
hf.titleZh: π^4:一个面向4D场景几何与运动的基础模型
hf.summaryZh: 从野外无标定的RGB观测(单图、无序图像集合或视频序列)中，一次性恢复稠密几何、相机位姿与度量尺度，并对多图输入给出2D/3D点轨迹与运动物体掩码。模型将几何分支与以几何为条件的运动分支耦合:运动分支预测图像空间对应关系，再借助重建的目标视角几何将其提升到3D。在多项基准上，几何评测取得最佳平均排名，单目与多目2D/3D点跟踪及运动物体分割也具竞争力;共享骨干的完整系统约0.5B参数，不到多数基线的一半，且单次前向即可完成联合重建与跟踪。训练上下文最多64视角，却能外推到含数千张图像的大规模场景，论文同时公开了数据与训练配方及关键设计选择的实证研究。
hf.reason: 4D场景重建与点跟踪，属视觉重建低分方向，与LLM无关

hf.title: From Repositories to Training Environments: Scaling Long-Horizon Coding Agents with Environment Evolution Loop
hf.abstract: Training coding agents for long-horizon tasks requires environments with verifiable feedback. Existing pipelines often follow a linear process that ends with validation, establishing usability but providing little guidance on improving training value. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) often requires model rollouts or model training followed by downstream evaluation, with costs and feedback delays amplified on long-horizon tasks. How can we use timely, reliable proxy signals to improve training value and synthesize environments at scale? We present RepoFactory, an automated pipeline that converts real repositories into verifiable environments where agents build complete projects from scratch given a language specification. Its Environment Evolution Loop optimizes a multiplicative objective combining validity, structural coupling, and implementation scope through proxy feedback. RepoFactory produces 10,159 environments across 17 software domains. Training Qwen3.5-35B-A3B on these environments yields RepoHorizen-35B-A3B, which achieves gains of 22.6 percentage points on NL2Repo-Bench and 8.5 points on average across five benchmarks covering long-horizon coding and agentic tasks in real-world production settings, compared with 17.5 and 6.4 points without environment evolution. These results highlight the training value of RepoFactory environments and the additional gains from the Environment Evolution Loop.
hf.titleZh: 从代码仓库到训练环境:用环境进化循环扩展长程编码智能体
hf.summaryZh: 把真实仓库自动转成可验证的训练环境，让智能体仅凭语言规格从零构建完整项目;针对现有流水线止步于可用性验证、递归自我改进反馈延迟大的问题，提出环境进化循环，用及时可靠的代理信号优化「有效性×结构耦合×实现范围」的乘积目标，规模化合成环境。产出覆盖17个软件域的10,159个环境，训练 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 得到 RepoHorizen-35B-A3B，在 NL2Repo-Bench 上提升22.6个百分点，五个长程编码与智能体基准平均提升8.5点(无环境进化为17.5与6.4点)。为编码智能体的环境合成与 Agentic RL 提供了可复用的规模化路径。
hf.reason: 面向长程编码智能体的可验证环境合成与训练，直接命中 Agent 与代码智能方向

hf.title: Beyond Answering: Learning to Speak First and Act in Streaming Video
hf.abstract: Most AI assistants respond only when prompted, remaining silent even when events in the video stream offer meaningful opportunities for conversation. To move beyond purely user-driven interaction, we present AURA 2.0, a streaming video large language model that introduces three core upgrades to AURA. The key advance is Model-Initiated Conversation (MIC), which enables the model to identify topics worth discussing in the evolving visual stream and initiate conversations at appropriate moments without a user query. Stream-Aware Tool Calling (SATC) lets the model act on what it sees by invoking external tools using the current visual and conversational context and incorporating returned information into the ongoing interaction. Interactive Visual Grounding (IVG) supports visual grounding in both user inputs and model outputs. The model can identify objects marked by users on video frames and produce frame-aligned bounding boxes to link its responses to specific objects and regions. To develop these capabilities, we construct a dedicated streaming interaction dataset and adopt a three-stage training scheme to integrate the new behaviors with AURA's existing streaming interaction abilities. We further incorporate Long-Horizon Interaction Memory (LHIM) to maintain contextual continuity over extended video streams. Evaluations on public streaming benchmarks show that AURA 2.0 achieves leading performance among open-source streaming models, while targeted evaluations further validate its new interaction capabilities.
hf.titleZh: 不止于回答：学习在流式视频中主动开口并行动
hf.summaryZh: 现有AI助手只在被提问时作答，流式视频中出现值得讨论的事件时仍保持沉默，错失主动交互机会。AURA 2.0作为流式视频大模型在AURA基础上引入三项能力：模型主动发起对话（MIC）——自行判断视觉流中值得讨论的话题并在合适时机开口；流感知工具调用（SATC）——结合当前视觉与对话上下文调用外部工具并把返回信息融入交互；交互式视觉定位（IVG）——识别用户在帧上标注的物体并输出帧对齐的边界框。工作还构建了专用流式交互数据集，采用三阶段训练整合新行为，并加入长时交互记忆（LHIM）维持长视频流的上下文连续性。公开流式benchmark上其在开源流式模型中表现领先，针对性评测进一步验证了上述新交互能力。
hf.reason: 流式视频MLLM加主动对话与工具调用，命中多模态理解与Agent方向

hf.title: FMT: Lossless Image Compression in a Fixed Number of Parallel Steps
hf.abstract: Learned lossless codecs make smaller files than common classical codecs, yet the images we archive and train on still use classical codecs. A main reason is time: a learned codec takes seconds to decode a photo that a classical codec opens in milliseconds, and their faster variants give up most of their gain in size. We argue that much of this time is spent waiting, not computing: the network waits for the values it conditions on, and the arithmetic decoder reads them one at a time. We introduce FMT (Fixed-step Multiscale Tree), a lossless image format whose decoding order and entropy coder are designed together so that neither wait grows with the image. FMT stores an image as a coarse-to-fine tree whose steps hold independent values: a GPU predicts each step at once and decodes it in parallel rANS lanes that carry their states from step to step, so an image of any size decodes in a fixed number of sequential steps. On this tree we build a family of bit-exact codecs, from a rule with no network to large networks, and no codec we ran on the same GPU beats any of them on both size and speed. Without a network, FMT beats NVIDIA's HTJ2K on size and speed; with a large one, it decodes Kodak photos 9 to 61X faster than learned codecs we ran on the same A100, at the same size or smaller.
hf.titleZh: FMT:在固定数量的并行步骤内完成的无损图像压缩
hf.summaryZh: 学习式无损编解码器压缩率优于经典编解码器，但解码一张照片需要数秒，而经典方法只需毫秒，原因是网络要等待条件值、算术解码器又逐符号串行读取。FMT 将解码顺序与熵编码器联合设计:图像被组织为从粗到细的树，每一步内的数值相互独立，GPU 可一次性并行预测整步，并由跨步携带状态的并行 rANS 通道完成解码，因此任意尺寸图像都只需固定数量的串行步骤。基于该树构建了从无网络规则到大网络的位精确编解码器族:无网络版本在体积与速度上均超过 NVIDIA HTJ2K;配大网络时在 A100 上解码 Kodak 照片比同环境学习式编解码器快 9 至 61 倍，且体积相同或更小。
hf.reason: 学习式图像压缩的并行化解码工程，与 LLM 后训练/Agent 方向无交集

hf.title: MedJev: A System One Vision-Language Decision Model for Fast and Effective Medical Image Understanding
hf.abstract: Medical image understanding with vision-language models (VLMs) typically relies on autoregressively generating reasoning and answer tokens. These unnecessary tokens make the inference cost scale with the response length and force the answer to be parsed from free-form text, incurring avoidable latency and decision errors. To this end, we introduce MedJev, a system one vision-language decision model that maps medical images, questions, and candidate answers directly to decisions in a single multimodal forward pass, without any autoregressive generation process. For fast inference, MedJev removes the upper language layers and the generative output pathway, while keeping the full vision pathway and all visual tokens. On this shortened backbone, a decision head scores each candidate by pretrained query--key matching and refines the scores with a lightweight multilayer perceptron (MLP) residual, coupling the pretrained matching structure with task-specific nonlinear discrimination. Built on Qwen3.5-4B, MedJev-4B improves both accuracy and speed over the original model on each of four medical image classification and visual question answering benchmarks, with an absolute accuracy gain of 7.93\% and a 6.04times end-to-end speedup. Further comparison with 20 cutting-edge models shows that MedJev-4B achieves state-of-the-art performance and inference speed among 4B--9B general and medical VLMs, indicating that direct multimodal decision making is an effective route to fast and effective medical image understanding.
hf.titleZh: MedJev：面向快速有效医学图像理解的系统一视觉语言决策模型
hf.summaryZh: 医学视觉语言模型的推理通常依赖自回归生成推理与答案 token，成本随回复长度增长，还需从自由文本解析答案。MedJev 将医学图像、问题与候选答案经单次多模态前向直接映射为决策：裁掉上层语言层与生成输出通路，保留完整视觉通路与视觉 token，并在缩短后的骨干上用预训练 query-key 匹配为候选打分，再由轻量 MLP 残差精修。基于 Qwen3.5-4B 的 MedJev-4B 在四个医学图像分类与视觉问答基准上均同时提升准确率与速度，绝对准确率提升 7.93%，端到端加速 6.04 倍，在 4B–9B 通用与医学 VLM 中达到领先性能与推理速度。
hf.reason: 医学 VLM 决策式推理，思路可借鉴但属垂直应用

hf.title: CADMAGEDDON: High-Fidelity CAD Reconstruction with Local Inference
hf.abstract: CAD practitioners often work with proprietary parts that they are unwilling to share with external services. For individuals and small companies, bringing this work in-house also requires computational resources they can afford. We introduce CADMAGEDDON, an open-source agent that reconstructs editable CAD from meshes and can run locally on single-GPU systems and current-generation laptops. The method decomposes this complex task into a chain of simple visual decisions about what to construct and what to correct. Geometric tools support precise construction, allowing the agent to focus on visual reasoning. Using the mid-sized Qwen3.8-27B model, CADMAGEDDON outperforms prior approaches, including systems based on frontier models, in reconstruction quality on all the main benchmarks. CADMAGEDDON integrates with FreeCAD, bringing its reconstructions into practitioners' existing CAD workflows. Code: https://github.com/kulibinai/cadmageddon
hf.titleZh: CADMAGEDDON:高保真CAD重建与本地推理
hf.summaryZh: 针对CAD从业者不愿将专有零件交给外部服务、又缺乏算力的痛点，把从网格重建可编辑CAD这一复杂任务拆解为「构建什么、修正什么」的链式简单视觉决策，几何工具负责精确构造，agent只承担视觉推理，因而可在单卡与当代笔记本上本地运行。使用中等规模的Qwen3.8-27B，在全部主要基准上的重建质量超过此前方法(含基于前沿模型的系统)，并接入FreeCAD融入既有工作流，代码已开源。适用于隐私敏感、算力受限场景下的本地逆向建模。
hf.reason: Agent拆解CAD重建任务，小模型本地推理超前沿模型，但领域偏3D重建

hf.title: MPEG-Diffusion: Mixed-Resolution Video Generation
hf.abstract: Video diffusion transformers (DiTs) generate realistic videos, but their heavy computational cost limits broader real-world applications. Mixed-resolution generation reduces this cost by generating the visually important region at high resolution (HR) and the rest at low resolution (LR), yet existing methods suffer a severe quality drop on videos and require knowing the HR region in advance. We show that these failures are not inherent to mixed resolution, and propose MPEG-Diffusion to address their three root causes: (1) dual-resolution attention to mitigate the curse of mixed resolution, where each query reads the K/V of its own resolution, (2) a mixed-resolution decoder to blend the HR and LR latents before decoding and resolve distortion, and (3) a self-selected HR region using the DiT's knowledge to find the visually important region without requiring it in advance. Processing only 30% of full-resolution tokens, MPEG-Diffusion speeds up denoising by 4.8times on Wan2.1 14B (3.8times on 1.3B), outperforming prior methods on nearly every metric. In the user study, we demonstrate the high quality of MPEG-Diffusion, with raters preferring it over prior mixed-resolution methods in over 90% of pairs and rating it close to full resolution.
hf.titleZh: MPEG-Diffusion:混合分辨率视频生成
hf.summaryZh: 视频 DiT 生成成本高昂，混合分辨率方案(重要区域高分辨率、其余低分辨率)可降低成本，但现有方法质量骤降，且需预先指定高分辨率区域。MPEG-Diffusion 针对三个根因分别设计:(1)双分辨率注意力，每个 query 只读取本分辨率的 K/V，缓解混合分辨率带来的退化;(2)混合分辨率解码器，在解码前融合 HR 与 LR latent 以消除失真;(3)借助 DiT 自身知识自选 HR 区域，无需预先给定。仅处理 30% 全分辨率 token,Wan2.1 14B 上去噪加速 4.8 倍(1.3B 上 3.8 倍)，多数指标优于先前方法;用户研究中 90% 以上成对比较优于既有混合分辨率方法，质量接近全分辨率。
hf.reason: 扩散视频生成，落在低分方向

hf.title: Agentic On-Policy Distillation Implicitly Reshapes LLMs' ReAct Patterns
hf.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) transfers specialized capabilities to language-model agents, but its cross-domain effects on interaction remain unclear. We investigate how OPD reshapes ReAct interaction patterns across mathematics, ALFWorld, and τ^2-bench, focusing on reasoning, actions, and observation acquisition. General-reasoning supervision reduces mathematical tool attempts from 70.4% to 14.4% while increasing accuracy from 16.7% to 38.0%; code-interpreter supervision improves household actions and retail queries. In contrast, ALFWorld supervision reduces τ^2-bench accuracy from 41.5% to 6.6%, accompanied by frequent tool calls that violate user-information dependencies. To address negative transfer using only source-domain training trajectories, we explore selective OPD guided by teacher preference changes before and after domain-specific RL. Retaining the top 95% of positions raises τ^2 accuracy from 11.5% to 29.9% with a source-learning trade-off.
hf.titleZh: Agentic同策略蒸馏隐式重塑LLM的ReAct模式
hf.summaryZh: 研究同策略蒸馏在数学、ALFWorld与τ²-bench上如何跨域重塑LLM智能体的ReAct交互模式，包括推理、动作与观测获取。通用推理监督使数学工具调用尝试从70.4%降至14.4%，准确率从16.7%升至38.0%；代码解释器监督改善家务动作与零售查询，而ALFWorld监督使τ²-bench准确率从41.5%降至6.6%，并伴随违反用户信息依赖的频繁工具调用。为缓解负迁移，利用领域RL前后教师偏好变化做选择性同策略蒸馏，保留前95%位置可将τ²准确率从11.5%提升至29.9%，但存在源域学习权衡。
hf.reason: Agentic同策略蒸馏与ReAct模式分析，直击后训练与Agent方向

hf.title: VisualArtifactSpec 1.0: Evaluating Visual Artifacts under Task Specifications
hf.abstract: Visual artifact tasks test agents' ability to translate task specifications and source materials into outputs that meet practical needs. Evaluation across artifact families helps distinguish broadly applicable authoring capabilities from strengths confined to a particular medium. We introduce VisualArtifactSpec 1.0 (VAS), a benchmark of 211 creation and modification tasks spanning presentations, static graphics, animations and videos, and web interfaces. Each task specifies authoring objectives, source materials, constraints, and deliverables. Existing benchmarks provide limited support for systematically evaluating how authoring choices suit different audiences, purposes, and media across artifact families. VAS evaluates two aspects separately: Task Fulfillment verifies explicit requirements and applicable functionality, while Artifact Performance assesses Content, Organization, Visuals, and Delivery. Task-specific rating anchors instantiate shared criteria for the intended audience, purpose, and medium, with judgments grounded in source materials and artifact inspection records. We evaluate nine model-harness configurations on all 211 tasks. Overall scores range from 42.12 to 70.52, with Artifact Performance accounting for 73.4% of the gap between the highest- and lowest-scoring configurations.
hf.titleZh: VisualArtifactSpec 1.0：在任务规范下评估视觉产物
hf.summaryZh: 现有基准难以系统衡量智能体能否把任务规范与素材转化为受众、用途与媒介都适配的实用产物。VAS 构建了 211 个创作与修改任务，覆盖演示文稿、静态图形、动画与视频、网页界面，每个任务都规定目标、素材、约束与交付物，并将评测拆为任务完成度（核查显式要求与功能）和产物表现（内容、组织、视觉、呈现，配任务专属评分锚点）。在全部任务上评测九种模型与 harness 组合，总分 42.12–70.52，最高与最低配置之间 73.4% 的差距来自产物表现维度。该基准可用于区分跨媒介通用的创作能力与局限于单一媒介的优势。
hf.reason: 智能体产物评测基准，涉及 harness 与 LLM-as-judge，但偏视觉创作

hf.title: Do LLM Agents Still Need to Be Told How to Self-Improve?
hf.abstract: LLM agents increasingly drive their own learning. Self-improvement methods delegate various components of model optimization to the models themselves. As models become more capable, this motivates a basic question: do these increasingly capable models still need us to specify how they should self-improve? In this paper we study an autonomous paradigm in which, given basic primitives, resources, and a general goal for self-improvement, agents construct their own self-learning algorithm for context-based optimization. Using the setting of gameplay as a testbed, a frozen LLM agent is given a compute budget and tools for collecting experience and updating text documents, and allowed to freely experiment without an externally imposed loop or access to real-world data. We find that sufficiently capable models do self-improve under these conditions, demonstrating strategies that align with classic cognitive frameworks for self-regulated learning and constructs from machine learning literature on self-generated curricula. Furthermore, we study the extent to which the learned text artifacts transfer to external benchmarks, observing improvement across different game horizons, mechanics, and 3D navigation.
hf.titleZh: LLM Agent 还需要被告知如何自我改进吗？
hf.summaryZh: 考察一个更自主的范式：只给定基本原语、资源与一个笼统的自我改进目标，让 Agent 自行构建基于上下文的自我学习算法。以游戏为试验台，冻结的 LLM 在算力预算内自由使用收集经验与更新文本文档的工具，不受外部循环约束、也无法访问真实数据。能力足够强的模型能自发涌现自我改进策略，且与自我调节学习的经典认知框架、自生成课程等机器学习概念相吻合；学到的文本产物还可迁移到不同游戏时间跨度、机制以及 3D 导航任务上并带来提升。这为把「如何自我改进」交由模型自行设计提供了实证依据。
hf.reason: Agent 自主设计自我改进算法，命中自进化与 Agent 方向

hf.title: DNeo: Your Parallel Draft Model Needs Better Target Feature Encoding
hf.abstract: Speculative-diffusion decoding uses a small parallel drafter model to generate b draft tokens in one forward pass, which then undergo parallel verification via a larger target model. Faster inference can be achieved when multiple draft tokens pass verification simultaneously. Recent parallel draft architectures (DFlash, DSpark) improve draft quality by conditioning on rich features computed by the target, through a mechanism known as feature encoding. However, standard feature encoding mechanisms have three limitations: (1) they are lossy, applying encoding projections that are destructive to the underlying target feature-space via a discovered effect known as residual mixing, (2) they are memory-less, with no record of previously processed proposals, and (3) they utilize features sampled uniformly from across the target layers, omitting important hidden states. To address these issues, we propose Mixture-of-Features Attention (MoFA), a lightweight feature-encoding approach equipped with a working memory that encodes previously rejected proposals. Leveraging MoFA, rejection memory, and a set of further enhancements, including 2-tap causal convolutions, prefix-only cross-attention, and non-uniform target layer selection, the final architecture, DNeo, achieves 1.3x faster generation speed than SoTA (DFlash-2) without impacting drafter footprint or generation quality. DNeo marks a new state of the art in high quality, fast LLM inference.
hf.titleZh: DNeo:你的并行草稿模型需要更好的目标特征编码
hf.summaryZh: 投机扩散解码依赖小型并行草稿模型一次前向生成多个候选 token，再由目标模型并行验证，验证通过越多加速越明显。针对现有特征编码机制存在的三个缺陷——投影编码破坏目标特征空间(残差混合)、无记忆、目标层特征均匀采样遗漏关键隐状态——提出 Mixture-of-Features Attention(MoFA)，以轻量注意力加工作记忆编码此前被拒绝的候选，并结合 2-tap 因果卷积、仅前缀交叉注意力与非均匀目标层选择构建 DNeo。在草稿模型参数量与生成质量不变的前提下，生成速度比 SoTA 的 DFlash-2 快 1.3 倍。
hf.reason: 投机解码架构改进，直击高效推理方向且结果扎实

hf.title: HubEgo-100K: In-the-Wild Egocentric Video of Skilled Work for Robot Learning
hf.abstract: Robot policies trained by imitation generalize poorly outside the environments and objects seen in training. Published data-scaling studies find that generalization grows with the diversity of training environments and objects rather than with more demonstrations per environment. Robot data is costly to collect across many environments, whereas egocentric human video can be recorded in the wild at scale; existing egocentric video, however, mostly shows daily-life activity and contains little skilled work in real workplaces. We present HubEgo-100K, a dataset built for diversity. This version of the paper covers the first release, v1.0: 10,124 hours of 1080p egocentric video with synchronized 100 Hz inertial (IMU) data from one head-mounted phone camera. In v1.0, 12,227 contributors record their own unscripted work in 15,548 environments (each one contributor's own setting of one type, such as their kitchen or workshop) across 11 setting types, 30 work categories, 56 task types and 35 action families, with 83% of hours in workplace settings. The release comprises 72,754 episodes with machine-generated action and language annotations, in LeRobot and MCAP formats under CC BY 4.0. We measure diversity along each axis, show that inside v1.0, with episodes in random order, new contributors and words keep appearing, and relate the measurements to published evidence on six data properties tied to policy performance, including hand visibility and inertial sensing. We also document collection, curation, privacy measures and data format, and provide a datasheet. Later versions of this paper will add benchmarks and cover further releases toward 100,000 hours.
hf.titleZh: HubEgo-100K:面向机器人学习的野外第一视角技能工作视频数据集
hf.summaryZh: 模仿学习得到的机器人策略在训练环境与物体之外泛化很差，而已有数据规模化研究显示泛化主要随环境与物体多样性增长、而非单环境演示数量;机器人数据跨环境采集昂贵，野外第一视角人类视频可大规模录制，但现有此类视频多为日常生活，缺少真实工作场所的技能劳动。HubEgo-100K v1.0以多样性为目标构建:头戴手机摄像头拍摄1080p第一视角视频并同步100Hz IMU,12,227名贡献者在15,548个环境、11类场景、30个工作类别、56种任务类型与35个动作族中自录无脚本工作，83%时长来自工作场所，共72,754个episode并附机器生成的动作与语言标注，以LeRobot与MCAP格式、CC BY 4.0发布。作者逐轴度量多样性，显示随机顺序采样下新贡献者与新词持续出现，并将度量与手部可见性、惯性传感等六项与策略性能相关的数据属性对照;该数据集为机器人学习提供多样性导向的野外数据来源，后续版本将扩至10万小时并补充基准。
hf.reason: 第一视角人类视频数据集，属数据与规模化擦边方向，非方法贡献

hf.title: The Noise Floor of a Quantization Comparison: Engine, restart, batch and kernel drift, measured against 8-bit and 4-bit effects in two decision models
hf.abstract: A quantized model is usually judged by comparing it with its BF16 original, but that comparison changes more than the weights. It often changes the serving engine, it always runs on a different server instance, it may change how requests are batched, and on some stacks the library selects a different kernel depending only on which packages import. We measure each of these sources on the same 2,400 public decisions for two of Cloudflare's decision models, Clef-flash (9B) and Clef (27B), on an NVIDIA GB10, and state every quantization effect as the excess over them. Sources that are not quantization move between 0 and 0.92% of decisions. llama.cpp restarts are bit-identical on every record for both models. vLLM restarts flip 0, 5 and 20 decisions at BF16, FP8 and NVFP4 on Clef-flash and 4, 0 and 22 on Clef; a third instance of Clef's quantized builds (exploratory) leaves FP8 at 0 and puts NVFP4 at 4 to 22, depending on which two instances are compared. An engine change at BF16 flips 6 to 16, a batch-size change 8 to 15, and the Gated DeltaNet kernel transformers selects unasked 10 to 14. Quantization inside one engine moves more: for Clef-flash and Clef, 0.88% and 1.04% at Q8_0, 2.12% and 1.62% at FP8, 5.79% and 3.50% at Q4_K_M, and 5.79% and 5.67% at NVFP4. On both models, every 4-bit interval excludes every non-quantization source. Two of our five pre-registered predictions failed, and the same two fail when the tests are rerun on the 27B: FP8 is not inside restart noise, and changing engine moves fewer decisions than 8-bit quantization does. Accuracy hides most of this. Over the full 31,275 public questions, Clef's Q4_K_M build moves accuracy by a net six questions (-0.02 points [-0.20, +0.16]) while 436 of its decisions get worse (exploratory), and NVFP4 costs Clef-flash 0.95 points and Clef 0.65. We release the code, quantization recipes, per-record outputs and the pre-registration.
hf.titleZh: 量化比较的噪声底线：在两款决策模型上以 8-bit 与 4-bit 效应为基准，测量引擎、重启、批次与 kernel 漂移
hf.summaryZh: 量化模型通常直接与 BF16 原版对比，但这一对比同时混入了 serving engine、服务器实例、batch 组成乃至库自动选择 kernel 等非量化变量。在 NVIDIA GB10 上，用 Cloudflare 两款决策模型 Clef-flash（9B）与 Clef（27B）的 2400 条公开决策，逐项测出这些噪声源：非量化因素会使 0–0.92% 的决策翻转，llama.cpp 重启逐位一致，而 vLLM 重启在 BF16/FP8/NVFP4 下最多翻转 22 条；引擎切换翻转 6–16 条，batch 变化 8–15 条，transformers 自动启用的 Gated DeltaNet kernel 翻转 10–14 条。量化本身影响更大，Q8_0/FP8/Q4_K_M/NVFP4 分别翻转 0.88%/2.12%/5.79%/5.79%（Clef-flash）与 1.04%/1.62%/3.50%/5.67%（Clef），两款模型上 4-bit 区间均与所有非量化噪声区间不相交。准确率则掩盖了这些差异：Clef 的 Q4_K_M 净变化仅 6 题（-0.02 点），却有 436 条决策变差。
hf.reason: 量化评测可靠性方法学，揭示对比噪声，属评测方法学扎实工作

hf.title: Glyph: An Interpretability Engine for AI-Driven Scientific Discovery in Clinical Data
hf.abstract: Automated scientific discovery has the potential to advance understanding of disease mechanisms and accelerate identification of early disease markers. Manual data annotation is infeasible at population scale, motivating methods that automatically extract pre-defined phenotypes in multimodal and unstructured clinical data. Such pre-defined feature sets determine and limit which associations these approaches can discover. This limitation extends to agentic AI systems that use these tools to query population-scale data. In contrast, foundation models (FMs) trained on large volumes of clinical data can perform tasks beyond their training objectives. This suggests their latent embeddings may represent novel or unexplored features that could yield insights into disease mechanisms, yet such latent features remain difficult to interpret. To address this challenge, we introduce Glyph, an automated multistage framework that extracts features from multimodal and unstructured clinical data using FMs and sparse autoencoders, interprets them as coded clinical concepts, and evaluates their value for clinical scientific discovery. We applied Glyph to abdominal CT volumes, CT radiology reports and laboratory measurements from 41,628 patients across different institutions. We identified 397 predictive concepts supported by 4,463 Bonferroni-significant associations. Moreover, a majority of discovered associations were automatically reproducible in held-out cohorts across different sites. Glyph concepts provided complementary associations to literature-derived markers, leading to gains in predictive power. We envision that interpretability can extend beyond a mechanistic understanding of neural networks to connecting implicitly learned features with clinical knowledge and establishing their significance for patient outcomes. We release Glyph at https://github.com/StanfordMIMI/Glyph.
hf.titleZh: Glyph:面向临床数据中 AI 驱动科学发现的可解释性引擎
hf.summaryZh: 临床数据规模下的自动化科学发现依赖预先定义的 phenotype 提取，特征集的封闭性直接限制了可发现的关联，而临床基础模型的隐表示虽可能蕴含新特征却难以解释。Glyph 用基础模型加稀疏自编码器从多模态非结构化临床数据中抽取特征，再将其解读为可编码的临床概念并评估其科研价值。在 41,628 名患者的腹部 CT 影像、CT 报告与化验数据上，该框架识别出 397 个预测性概念，支撑 4,463 条 Bonferroni 显著关联，且多数关联在跨机构留出队列中可自动复现，并与文献来源标记形成互补、提升预测能力。工作把可解释性从网络机制理解延伸到连接隐式特征与临床知识。
hf.reason: 临床影像与生物医学应用为主，SAE 可解释性仅边缘相关

hf.title: ResWAM: Learning What Changes, Not What Stays, for World-Action Models
hf.abstract: World-action models (WAMs) augment vision-language-action policies (VLAs) with future prediction so that the policy can anticipate how its actions will affect the physical world. Existing WAMs supervise complete future observations. However, observations typically change little over an action chunk, so the future loss is dominated by copying static background content rather than learning task-relevant robot and object motion, limiting policy learning. Moreover, existing WAMs rely on large video generation models or separate world models, incurring heavy training and inference compute that hinders closed-loop deployment. To improve policy performance, we propose visual residual learning, supervising only the feature change from the current frame to the future frame in a frozen DINOv3 space. Compared with complete future features, this residual learning target yields a higher feature rank with richer and more diverse representations of scene changes, and spatially concentrates on the robot arm and manipulated objects rather than the background. To further improve computational efficiency, we present ResWAM, a residual world-action model with 2.3B parameters in total, including a lightweight 0.5B dual-branch DiT that jointly trains an action branch and a residual branch via conditional flow matching. Without robot pretraining (i.e., pretraining on external robot action trajectories beyond the benchmark demonstrations), ResWAM achieves top average success rates on LIBERO-Plus (81.1%), RoboTwin 2.0 (93.8%), and RoboDojo (9.40% success, 13.41 score) at the lowest training (2.7-4.0 TFLOPs) and inference compute (1.0-1.4 TFLOPs), and leads real-robot Open, Put, and Stack (80.0% average, +10.0% over π_{0.5}) at 92.7 ms latency.
hf.titleZh: ResWAM：为世界-动作模型学习变化之处，而非静止之处
hf.summaryZh: 现有世界-动作模型对未来观测做完整监督，但一个动作块内画面变化很小，损失被静态背景的复制占主导，任务相关的机械臂与物体运动反而学不到；这类模型还依赖大视频生成模型或独立世界模型，训练与推理算力开销大。ResWAM改为在冻结的DINOv3特征空间中只监督当前帧到未来帧的特征残差，该目标特征秩更高，且空间上集中于机械臂与被操作物体。模型总参数2.3B，含一个0.5B双分支DiT，以条件流匹配联合训练动作分支与残差分支。无机器人预训练情况下在LIBERO-Plus（81.1%）、RoboTwin 2.0（93.8%）、RoboDojo（9.40%）取得最高平均成功率，训练与推理算力最低（2.7–4.0与1.0–1.4 TFLOPs），真机Open、Put、Stack平均80.0%、较π0.5提升10个点，延迟92.7 ms。
hf.reason: WAM监督目标有新意，效率与真机结果扎实，直击VLA与WAM方向

hf.title: MillBill: A Machining Agent with Geometric Feedback
hf.abstract: Turning a CAD model into a machining program requires both process knowledge and geometric precision. Language models can generate such workflows by writing geometry and toolpath code for each part, but this makes numerical execution part of the model's task. We introduce MillBill, an agent that separates machining decisions from their geometric execution and verification. Given a boundary-representation part, stock, and material, a locally hosted, mid-sized open model proposes operations and cutting parameters for indexed three-axis machining. A geometric harness generates toolpaths, simulates material removal, and returns feedback for plan refinement. Setup planning accounts for what the available cutters can physically reach, rather than visibility alone. We evaluate the resulting programs by the fraction of the target surface area within the specified tolerance after simulated machining. With Qwen3.8-27B, MillBill outperforms frontier-model approaches that construct their own geometry and toolpath workflows on the evaluated machining tasks. Code: https://github.com/kulibinai/millbill
hf.titleZh: MillBill:一个带几何反馈的加工智能体
hf.summaryZh: 把 CAD 模型转成加工(CNC)程序既需要工艺知识，也需要几何精度;如果让语言模型直接编写几何和刀路代码，数值执行就被压进了模型的任务里。MillBill 把加工决策与几何执行、验证拆开:本地部署的中等规模开源模型只负责为三轴加工提议工序与切削参数，几何 harness 负责生成刀路、模拟材料去除，并把反馈回传给模型以迭代计划;装夹规划按刀具实际可达性判断，而非仅依据可见性。以仿真加工后落在公差内的目标表面积占比为指标，Qwen3-27B 驱动的 MillBill 在评测的加工任务上优于自行构造几何与刀路流程的前沿模型。工作面向 CAM 与制造领域的智能体化。
hf.reason: 制造/CAM 垂直应用，agent 与反馈机制沾边但非核心方向

hf.title: AuXSpec: Learning to Autoformalize Program Specifications via Executable Postconditions
hf.abstract: Formal specifications define intended program behavior and underpin verification, but writing them in theorem provers such as Lean is slow and expertise-intensive, making specification a major bottleneck to scaling formally correct code. Autoformalization from natural-language problems is promising, yet training specification models requires scalable feedback on whether generated specifications capture intended behavior. Prior approaches obtain this feedback through explicit proofs or separately implemented code with formal correspondence proofs, both expensive. We introduce AuXSpec, a Lean framework that pairs declarative postconditions with executable counterparts, obtained through type class resolution when possible and otherwise defined separately with an equivalence proof. Test cases can then evaluate declarative specifications by execution, letting us use agreement as a reinforcement-learning reward. Using AuXSpec, we synthesize 3,037 LeetCode problems and expand training to 19.5K samples through expert iteration on Codeforces. Experiments show that training Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.8-27B with the execution-based reward improves SpecGen pass@4 on AuXSpec-Test 0.7% to 82.7% and 14.3% to 84.3%, and the 27B model outperforms all frontier models. On the out-of-domain Verina benchmark with its original prompts, both models improve 7.0% to 90.5% and 21.9% to 90.5% and surpass VeriSpecGen-30B-A3B, the prior state of the art among open-source specification models, on pass@1 (theirs 47.6% vs. ours 73.7% and 84.5%) and pass@4 (theirs 63.9% at pass@10 vs. ours 90.5%). We release the weights of the trained 9B and 27B models and the 3,037 problems with test cases, including the 300-problem AuXSpec-Test benchmark with expert review and correctness proofs for future evaluation. Models and data: https://huggingface.co/collections/eth-algopt/auxspec. Website: https://auxspec.org
hf.titleZh: AuXSpec:通过可执行后置条件学习自动形式化程序规约
hf.summaryZh: 从自然语言题目自动形式化出 Lean 规约缺乏可扩展的反馈信号，现有做法依赖显式证明，或另行实现代码并证明形式对应，代价高昂。AuXSpec 把声明式后置条件与可执行实现配对:能通过类型类解析自动获得可执行版本，否则单独实现并给出等价性证明，从而可用测试用例执行来检验声明式规约，并以执行一致性作为强化学习奖励。基于 3,037 道 LeetCode 题合成数据，并在 Codeforces 上做专家迭代扩到 19.5K 样本，训练 Qwen3.5-9B 与 Qwen3.8-27B 后 SpecGen pass@4 由 0.7%/14.3% 升至 82.7%/84.3%,27B 模型超过所有前沿模型;域外 Verina 上两模型 pass@1 由 7.0%/21.9% 升至 90.5%，超过开源 SOTA VeriSpecGen-30B-A3B。
hf.reason: Lean 规约自动形式化，以执行反馈做 RL 奖励，命中代码智能与 RLVR

hf.title: Attention at Absolute Zero
hf.abstract: Attention scores candidate supports of an answer, which we call witnesses, and reads the scores at a temperature. We build a higher-order attention layer whose state lives on pairs of items: for a pair (a, b), each third item k is a witness judged through its legs (a, k) and (k, b). It reads witnesses at zero temperature, keeping the best and the number tied with it, passes on only bits comparing such counts, rebuilds its pair state from the input and these bits at every loop, and is trained from answers alone. Each choice removes one way soft attention fails at size: dispersed weight, unresolved gaps between learned scores, and a drifting soft state. In maximum retrieval it is right on at least 99.95% of sets 1,000 times larger than in training, on all ten seeds; trained with a soft count, the same network falls to 42% at 4,096 items. On CLRS-30 without hints, a general form of the layer (half its channels read at zero temperature, numbers embedded, state carried) beats the best published model, which uses hints on some tasks; the full cold layer is exact on every test input of 9 of the 12 tasks whose answers depend on numbers only through comparisons. From yes-or-no answers it decides 2-SAT and two-colouring exactly at 500 variables and, as our theory predicts, not parity equations. Beside a frozen 7B language model it chains family relations exactly at 1,000 statements after training on 16, where the model alone falls to 44%; finite checks on the weights prove every block that learned correct at every size, on acyclic contexts and given what the model reads. On CLUTRR it is right on every story of five to ten relations given the graphs, learning the 62 rules exactly; from text, with the model frozen, no hand-written rule and only a small read-in trained, it lifts an open 7B model from 33% to 65%, above every system we found without hand-written rules except frontier reasoning models.
hf.titleZh: 绝对零度的注意力
hf.summaryZh: 针对soft attention在规模扩大时的三种失效——权重分散、学习分数之间的间隙不收敛、软状态漂移——构建高阶注意力层：状态定义在元素对上，第三个元素作为见证（witness），以零温度读取最优见证与并列计数，只传递比较计数的比特，每轮从输入与比特重建对状态，仅用答案训练。在最大检索任务上，规模为训练集的1000倍时正确率仍≥99.95%（10个种子），而软计数版本在4096项时跌至42%；CLRS-30无提示下超过最佳已发表模型；CLUTRR由33%提升至65%。为硬注意力与精确组合推理给出了可验证的架构路线。
hf.reason: 零温度硬注意力＋高阶关系推理，方法新颖、结果可验证

arxiv.title: Equal Steps, Unequal Curvature: Where Muon's Update Goes Wrong
arxiv.abstract: Muon updates each hidden weight matrix along the polar factor of its momentum, the steepest-descent direction under the spectral norm. That choice fixes two allocations without consulting the loss: every singular direction of the momentum receives the same step, and in a non-square matrix each neuron's step is set by its leverage score. Whether they are good is a question about curvature, which steepest-descent arguments do not answer; we measure it. Using held-out gradients and Hessian-vector products, we decompose Muon's step by singular-value band and by neuron group and compute each group's second-order optimal multiplier. In a 124M-parameter decoder trained on FineWeb-Edu, the multipliers rise monotonically from the top singular directions to the tail: Muon over-steps the high-curvature top of its spectrum. We prove in Lean when such a diagnostic licenses an intervention at Muon's own update norm. On the measured curvature, the criterion predicts, and held-out losses confirm, that moving step length off the top helps mid-training and early in the cooldown, but not at its end. We then test interventions under per-step norm matching, tuned baselines and paired seeds. Orthogonalizing Q, K and V separately rather than as one fused matrix lowers the loss by 0.0250 nats and accounts for all of the gain of block-wise variants. A matmul-only, rotation-equivariant spectral tilt $σ^{-1/4}$ applied in the cooldown lowers the loss of this stronger baseline by a further 0.0120 nats, additively with NorMuon (0.0158 nats together, three seeds; the baseline needs about 4.3% more tokens to match), and by 0.0188 nats at 355M parameters (three seeds). Energy-matched Schatten-1 weight decay adds a further 0.0052 nats. Geometrically principled changes that do not act on the measured miscalibration, namely exact polar factors, steepest-descent input whitening and top-heavy decay, do not help.
arxiv.titleZh: 等步长，不等曲率：Muon 更新错在何处
arxiv.summaryZh: Muon 沿动量的极分解方向更新每个权重矩阵，这等价于对所有奇异方向取同一步长、非方阵中按 leverage score 分配各神经元步长，两项分配都不参考损失；是否合理只能由曲率回答。按奇异值带与神经元组分解 held-out 梯度与 Hessian-vector product，计算各组二阶最优乘子，并用 Lean 证明何种诊断支持在 Muon 自身更新范数下干预。在 124M decoder 上，乘子由谱顶部向尾部单调上升，即 Muon 对高曲率顶部过步，该判据预测 mid-training 与 cooldown 早期移出顶部步长有益、末期无益。干预实验中 Q/K/V 分开正交化降 0.0250 nats，σ^{-1/4} 谱倾斜再降 0.0120 nats（叠加 NorMuon 共 0.0158，355M 上 0.0188 nats），精确极分解与输入白化等几何改动则无效。
arxiv.reason: Muon 优化器的曲率诊断与实证改进，直接命中预训练优化器方向

arxiv.title: Semantic Context Handoff with On-Demand Evidence for Long-Horizon Agents
arxiv.abstract: Traditional long-horizon LLM agents often hand off context through full-history prompting, retaining all previous action--observation interactions. As execution proceeds, this history keeps growing, increasing inference cost and potentially degrading accuracy. Existing methods control this growth by preserving compact conclusions while removing earlier observations, but doing so can discard evidence that later becomes relevant. We introduce Semantic Context Handoff (SCH), whose central abstraction is state--evidence separation: a compact semantic state carries the agent's current interpretation, while supporting action--observation evidence remains separately addressable and can re-enter context when later execution makes it relevant, without separate summarization or retrieval-model calls. Empirically, SCH improves long-horizon agent performance while substantially reducing context cost. In a controlled 150-task SWE-bench study, SCH's evidence recovery improves Pass@1 from $80.0\%$ to $86.9\%$ at essentially unchanged token use and execution time. In the complete-system comparison, SCH achieves 86.9% Pass@1 while using 43% fewer tokens and 41% less wall-clock time than the strongest baseline by task performance. Across models and benchmarks, SCH consistently reduces token use relative to full-history prompting while remaining competitive with or improving upon the evaluated baselines. Trajectory analysis confirms that SCH recovers evidence from substantially earlier parts of the interaction history rather than merely preserving a recent context window.
arxiv.titleZh: 语义上下文交接：面向长程 Agent 的按需证据检索
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对长程 Agent 全历史提示导致上下文持续膨胀、推理成本上升且准确率下降的问题，提出语义上下文交接（SCH），以「状态—证据分离」为核心：紧凑的语义状态承载 Agent 当前理解，动作—观测证据单独可寻址，在后续执行需要时重新进入上下文，无需额外摘要或检索模型调用。在 150 个任务的 SWE-bench 受控实验中，证据恢复将 Pass@1 从 80.0% 提升到 86.9%，token 用量与执行时间基本不变；完整系统对比中，SCH 以 86.9% 的 Pass@1 比最强基线少用 43% token 与 41% 实际耗时。轨迹分析显示其能召回交互历史中较早的证据，而非仅保留近期窗口。
arxiv.reason: 长程 Agent 上下文管理新范式，SWE-bench 有数据提升，直击 Agent 方向

arxiv.title: Replay, Don't Resample: Off-Policy Consolidation of Long-Horizon RL Experts
arxiv.abstract: Frontier post-training follows a common recipe: train one expert per domain with reinforcement learning (RL), then consolidate the experts into one model via multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD). Such consolidation is expensive: the student samples in every environment again, an expert scores every sampled token, and the student inherits the drift of the final experts. Yet we argue that the experts' RL runs have already produced what consolidation needs: rollouts with their sampling probabilities and rewards, in the order the experts learned from them. We propose multi-expert replay policy distillation (MRPD), which replays these training logs through the student in the experts' order. At each step, the policy gradient is recomputed on these scored trajectories, and the final experts' distributions are distilled at the logged prefixes. Following the experts' own trajectory reduces the training-inference mismatch and keeps the student within the clip range, so the replay is off-policy in origin but quasi-on-policy throughout consolidation. MRPD samples nothing and calls no environment or reward model: the trainer is the sole process, and consolidating the experts costs only about a seventh of the compute used to train them. On three long-horizon agentic domains (reasoning, search and SQL), MRPD yields the best student model, substantially outperforming online RL baselines, and surpassing MOPD from the same experts at a fraction of MOPD's cost. Our analysis on the same logs shows that the replayed trajectories carry most of the gain, and that both the policy gradient and the distillation term add to it. Most interestingly, the order of the logs matters more than their amount or rewards, suggesting that expert training logs are a curriculum, not a data mixture.
arxiv.titleZh: 重放而非重采样:长时程 RL 专家的离策略整合
arxiv.summaryZh: 多教师 on-policy 蒸馏要把各领域 RL 专家合并成一个模型，却需要学生在每个环境重新采样、专家逐 token 打分，成本高且会继承最终专家的漂移。MRPD 改为直接重放专家的 RL 训练日志:按专家学习顺序回放带采样概率与奖励的轨迹，在记录前缀上重算策略梯度并蒸馏最终专家分布，从而让原本离策略的重放在整合全程近似 on-policy，训练器是唯一进程，不调用环境与奖励模型。在推理、搜索、SQL 三个长时程 Agent 域上，得到的学生模型优于在线 RL 基线，并以约七分之一的训练算力超过 MOPD;分析还显示轨迹回放贡献了主要增益，日志顺序比数量与奖励更重要，说明专家训练日志更接近课程而非数据混合。
arxiv.reason: 重放专家日志替代 on-policy 蒸馏，直击后训练与 Agent 整合方向

arxiv.title: Toaster: Nonlinear Memory from Cascaded Linear Memories and Target Propagation
arxiv.abstract: Recurrent memories let language models process long sequences with a fixed-size state. Linear memories such as DeltaNet and KDA store one matrix and take one delta-rule step per token. The product of a chunk of such steps has an exact WY form, so they train fast. Deep memories such as TTT-MLP and Titans store a small MLP, which can hold maps that no matrix can, but their update has no WY form. Toaster bridges the two by building on a known fact: a gradient step on a linear layer is a delta-rule write. It builds a two-layer nonlinear memory from two linear memories with an activation between them. We use target propagation to give the hidden memory its values by projecting the output error back through the second memory. Given a chunk's cross-layer signals, approximated once per chunk, each layer can then run on an unmodified delta-rule kernel. Our default runs this kernel on the output layer and updates the hidden layer once per chunk. Running it on both layers gives a better model in our ablation. At matched backbones and training-token budgets, Toaster has lower loss than KDA at all five tested sizes (0.2B-1.6B non-embedding parameters) on both C4 and PG19. Its C4 perplexity also matches or slightly improves on the attention baseline at every size. At 1.2B it is also below Titans. In a 3:1 hybrid with global attention, the Toaster hybrid has the lowest perplexity of the four hybrids tested, and it is 0.18 (C4) and 0.44 (PG19) below the attention baseline. At the largest size, Toaster's mean three-shot accuracy on 13 tasks is 51.84%, compared with 50.52% for KDA and 50.04% for Titans. In length extrapolation, Toaster's loss stays below KDA's up to 20K tokens (5x the training length). On the 145M backbone, at a hidden width matched to Titans' memory, Toaster takes at most 1.33x KDA's training-step time and is 2.8-5.5x faster than the tested Titans configurations at 32K context.
arxiv.titleZh: Toaster:由级联线性记忆与目标传播构建的非线性记忆
arxiv.summaryZh: 线性循环记忆(DeltaNet、KDA)每 token 做一次 delta-rule 写入，可写成 WY 形式而训练高效;TTT-MLP、Titans 等深度记忆容量更大却失去该形式。Toaster 依据「线性层的梯度步即 delta-rule 写入」，将两层线性记忆中间夹激活级联为非线性记忆，并用目标传播把输出误差经第二层投影回隐层，跨层信号每 chunk 近似一次，两层各自跑未改动的 delta-rule 内核。0.2B–1.6B 五个规模上 C4 与 PG19 损失均低于 KDA,C4 困惑度持平或略优于注意力基线;13 项三-shot 平均 51.84%，高于 KDA 的 50.52% 与 Titans 的 50.04%,32K 上下文下训练步时最多为 KDA 的 1.33 倍、比 Titans 快 2.8–5.5 倍。
arxiv.reason: 线性记忆新架构，结果扎实覆盖多规模，直接命中架构方向

arxiv.title: Cap-and-Track: Optimizing LLM Inference Request Dispatch Across Shifting Capacity
arxiv.abstract: A fixed dispatch rate for LLM inference becomes stale as serving fleets resize and request sizes change. Generative output length is unknown at admission, and shared provider pools can lose capacity. We present Cap-and-Track, a design for asynchronous inference across provider capacity and internal GPUs. Meta's traffic shaper implements Cap-and-Track for post and live-video understanding. Refusals signal the backend's current admission ceiling. Durable priority queues hold excess work outside execution, including refused requests for retry. Cap is a fail-fast admission check at the saturated resource that refuses work before a long wait. Using only those refusals, the Track dispatcher probes upward and backs off. It follows the ceiling without output-length prediction or a fleet-level rate to retune. In a concurrent same-traffic production A/B, the shaper ran per-replica Cap plus Track. It served a classifier on 43% fewer H100s than its queued, fixed-rate precursor, though lower-priority work waited longer at backfill peaks. In steady-capacity real-engine replay, Track ran within 1% of the goodput of a fixed rate tuned above measured capacity, with about a quarter of that rate's refusal share. The shaper carries more than 300 million online requests and hundreds of terabytes of media a day. During a backfill, it handled 1.1 billion requests in its busiest 24 hours. Lessons include keeping queues inside inference engines just long enough to fill batches, steering dispatch by capacity refusals alone, keeping dispatch stateful, and sizing fleets by how long low-priority work can wait.
arxiv.titleZh: Cap-and-Track:在容量变动下优化 LLM 推理请求调度
arxiv.summaryZh: 固定调度速率在服务集群伸缩与请求长度变化时会失效，而生成输出长度在准入时未知，共享 provider 池还可能失容。Cap-and-Track 在外部 provider 容量与内部 GPU 之间异步调度推理请求:在饱和资源上做快速失败的准入检查(Cap)，用持久化优先级队列把超额请求与被拒请求暂存在执行之外以便重试，再仅凭拒绝信号向上探测并退避(Track)，无需预测输出长度或重调全局速率。生产环境同流量 A/B 中，分类器服务所用 H100 比排队式固定速率前身少 43%;稳态真实引擎回放中，Track 的 goodput 与高于实测容量的调优固定速率相差 1% 以内，拒绝比例约为其四分之一。系统日承载超 3 亿在线请求，峰值 24 小时处理 11 亿请求。
arxiv.reason: 生产级 LLM 推理调度系统，机制新颖、数据扎实

arxiv.title: Communicative On-Policy Distillation: Distilling Black-Box Teacher Capabilities through Communication for Long-Horizon Tasks
arxiv.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) is a powerful paradigm for improving language-model agents on long-horizon tasks, yet its conventional formulation relies on teacher logits that text-only black- box models do not expose. To address this limitation, we introduce Communicative On-Policy Distillation (COPD), which uses natural-language communication as a medium for distilling a stronger model's capabilities into a smaller student. During task execution, the student au- tonomously decides when to consult a black-box teacher and formulates open-ended natural- language requests without predefined question templates or intervention schedules. Successful student-teacher interactions are retained as privileged references to supervise fresh adviser-free student rollouts through on-policy self-distillation, jointly with task-reward reinforcement learning. On CAMG-II, COPD achieves 2.46 times the gain of the strongest black-box OPD baseline. The capabilities it learns through communication generalize to Terminal-Bench 2.1 and SWE-Bench Pro V2, improving task success without adviser access.
arxiv.titleZh: 交际式在线策略蒸馏：通过交流蒸馏黑盒教师能力以完成长时程任务
arxiv.summaryZh: 黑盒教师不暴露logits，常规在线策略蒸馏（OPD）因而无法直接用于长时程Agent。COPD以自然语言交流为蒸馏媒介：学生执行任务时自主决定何时向黑盒教师求助，并自行组织开放式请求，无需预设提问模板或干预排程；成功的师生交互被保留为特权参考，用于对无顾问的学生新rollout做在线自蒸馏，并与任务奖励强化学习联合优化。在CAMG-II上收益达最强黑盒OPD基线的2.46倍，所学能力可迁移到Terminal-Bench 2.1与SWE-Bench Pro V2，在无顾问访问条件下提升任务成功率。
arxiv.reason: 黑盒教师在线蒸馏＋长时程Agent，正落后训练与Agent方向

arxiv.title: Agentic Harness Engineering Beta: Requirement-Centered Evolution of Agent Harnesses
arxiv.abstract: Real-world harness engineering is driven by explicit and implicit user requirements, which guide development and validation. However, existing harness evolution methods often overlook implicit requirements and interaction needs, while using a single evolution agent to modify the harness and benchmark scores to select changes. This process often produces narrow patches and leads to benchmark-specific local optima. We introduce Agentic Harness Engineering Beta (AHE-Beta), a requirement-centered loop that brings real-world engineering practices into harness evolution. The loop consists of three steps: (1) User-driven evaluation lets simulated users raise their requirements as issues while they work with the harness over multiple turns. (2) Team-based modification implements those requirements as generalizable changes rather than task-specific patches. (3) Requirement-driven selection merges a change only when it resolves a verified requirement and passes review. Empirically, on held-out tasks, AHE-Beta raises pass@1 from 21.9% to 33.3% while using 40.8% fewer tokens than Base Harness, and achieves higher pass@1 than Claude Code, Meta-Harness, and AHE. In a blind human A/B test, real users prefer AHE-Beta in 31 of 48 valid pairs and rate it higher on all five dimensions, matching the directional preference of the user simulator. The human A/B results show that AHE-Beta achieves its goal of aligning harness evolution with real-world user requirements. Without further evolution, the gains transfer to GLM-5.3 and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash with pass@1 improvements of 15.8% and 5.3% over Base Harness. Together, these results show that requirement-centered harness evolution is a more general method for improving agent capabilities.
arxiv.titleZh: Agentic Harness Engineering Beta:以需求为中心的智能体外壳演进
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对现有外壳演进方法忽视隐性需求与交互需求、且依赖单一演进智能体打补丁和用基准分数选改从而陷入基准特定局部最优的问题，提出以需求为中心的演进闭环:模拟用户在多轮使用中把需求提成 issue，由团队式修改将需求实现为可泛化的改动，仅在改动解决已验证需求并通过评审时才合并。在留出任务上，pass@1 从 21.9% 提升到 33.3%,token 用量比 Base Harness 少 40.8%，并高于 Claude Code、Meta-Harness 与 AHE;48 组盲测人工 A/B 中用户 31 次偏好 AHE-Beta，五个维度评分均更高。未经额外演进，增益可迁移到 GLM-5.3 与 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash,pass@1 分别再提升 15.8% 与 5.3%。
arxiv.reason: Agent harness 自动演进，命中 Agent 与后训练方向

arxiv.title: On Evaluating User Simulators for Interactive Agents
arxiv.abstract: User simulators offer a scalable way to evaluate interactive agents, but how to assess their quality remains underexplored. In particular, it is unclear whether existing user simulator evaluation frameworks reliably detect meaningful failures in simulated user behavior. This uncertainty makes it difficult to interpret simulator evaluation. To understand what a high benchmark score tells us about simulator quality, we (meta-)evaluate the metrics themselves. To instantiate this meta-evaluation, we deliberately perturb simulated replays to induce failures such as altered goals, omitted constraints, premature stopping, and acceptance of broken work, then test whether the metrics penalize these failures. Evaluation methods from three prior studies detect only 5-6 of the 10 perturbations; their combined scores even favor populations instructed to accept broken work over unmodified controls. Motivated by these gaps, we propose a new evaluation suite that combines utility of user simulators for evaluating agents and two measures of fidelity to real users: population-level fidelity assesses collective interaction patterns, while trace-level fidelity assesses the preservation of individual users' goals, constraints, and persona. Under the same detection criterion, our evaluation suite detects all 10 perturbations. Evaluating six user simulators on 351 real multi-turn sessions in which 348 distinct users across 23 languages and agents work together to create and refine artifacts such as full-stack web apps, games, design assets, and automated workflows, we find that population-level measures can miss when a simulated user pursues the wrong goal, ignores a constraint, or behaves out of character, highlighting the need to assess fidelity at comprehensive granularities.
arxiv.titleZh: 论交互式 Agent 的用户模拟器评测
arxiv.summaryZh: 交互式 Agent 的评测依赖用户模拟器，但模拟器自身的评测是否可靠尚不清楚。该工作对既有指标做元评测:扰动模拟回放，注入目标改变、约束遗漏、过早终止、接受劣质产物等10类失败，检验指标能否识别。三项先前方法仅检出5–6类，合并得分甚至偏好被要求接受劣质产物的模拟人群。为此提出的评测套件结合模拟器效用与群体级、轨迹级两层保真度，在同一标准下检出全部10类;在23种语言、348名真实用户的351段多轮会话上评测六个模拟器，显示群体级指标会漏掉目标错误、忽略约束与人格走样。
arxiv.reason: Agent 用户模拟器评测的方法学工作，直接命中评测方向

arxiv.title: General progress substitutes for specific training data in language models
arxiv.abstract: Language models acquire their capabilities from training data, and developers withhold data during training to keep models from learning capabilities that could be misused. How long this delays a capability, and how much data is needed to acquire it later, is unknown. Here we show that the general progress a model makes on the rest of its training data substitutes for the data that was withheld. We withheld the training signal for individual skills in models of chess, Othello, molecular strings, bracket languages and web text. The delay of a withheld skill in larger models was predicted from smaller ones. A chess model never explicitly trained to respond to check ranked the legal responses almost as well as a model that was. When models were then trained on the withheld data, they acquired the skill with a small fraction of the data needed from initialization, and this fraction decreased as the models progressed. A control rule of equal difficulty was learned much more slowly. A programming language withheld from the training text of a 7-billion-parameter model was regained in the same way. Data filtering therefore delays a capability, and the data required to regain it decreases as models improve.
arxiv.titleZh: 通用进步可替代语言模型中的特定训练数据
arxiv.summaryZh: 研究训练数据被过滤或扣留后，能力被延迟多久、重新习得又需要多少数据。在象棋、黑白棋、分子字符串、括号语言与网页文本中分别扣留单项技能的训练信号，发现模型在其余数据上的通用进步可替代被扣留的数据:大模型的能力延迟可由小模型预测;重新加入被扣留数据后，只需从零训练所需数据的一小部分即可掌握该技能，且这一比例随模型变强而下降;同等难度的对照规则学习明显更慢;7B 参数模型中被剔除的编程语言同样如此。数据过滤只是延迟而非消除能力，对预训练数据配比与安全过滤策略有直接含义。
arxiv.reason: 预训练数据过滤与能力习得机制，实验系统且覆盖7B模型

arxiv.title: On-Policy Morphing into Hybrid Attention Models
arxiv.abstract: Hybrid attention models combine full and linear attention to achieve a better quality--efficiency trade-off. Converting pretrained Transformers into such models requires identifying which layers should retain full attention under a prescribed budget. We identify two off-policy mismatches in FlashMorph's layer selection: (i) continuous branch interpolation and teacher-forced hidden states differ from discrete hybrid computation; and (ii) frozen model weights fail to account for parameter adaptation during subsequent recovery. We introduce FlashMorph2, an on-policy layer-selection method that (I) evaluates sampled discrete hybrid architectures end to end using their own hidden states, and (II) jointly optimizes layer-selection scores and model weights under the recovery objective to reflect post-adaptation performance. Experiments across Qwen3 model scales and linear-attention variants show that FlashMorph2 consistently outperforms existing layer-selection methods, improving average scores over FlashMorph by $+2.42$ points on RULER, $+1.08$ on LongBench, and $+0.76$ on recall-intensive tasks, while completing layer selection in only $0.72$--$3.57$ GPU hours across 0.6B--8B models, demonstrating high efficiency and scalability.
arxiv.titleZh: On-Policy 变形为混合注意力模型
