arxiv.summaryZh: 把预训练 Transformer 转成混合注意力模型时，需在给定预算下确定哪些层保留全注意力。该工作指出 FlashMorph 的层选择存在两处 off-policy 偏差:连续分支插值与 teacher-forcing 隐状态同离散混合计算不一致;冻结权重也忽略了后续恢复阶段的参数适配。为此提出 FlashMorph2，用采样出的离散混合架构以自身隐状态端到端评估，并在恢复目标下联合优化层选择分数与模型权重。在 Qwen3 各规模与多种线性注意力变体上，其 RULER 平均分比 FlashMorph 高 2.42、LongBench 高 1.08、召回密集型任务高 0.76，层选择仅耗 0.72--3.57 GPU 小时(0.6B--8B)。
arxiv.reason: 混合注意力层选择，直击架构改造与效率，数据扎实

arxiv.title: Openhagen Worlds: Calibrated Environments for Measuring and Training Scientific Discovery Agents
arxiv.abstract: Agents that do science must choose informative experiments and reason from their results, but most discovery benchmarks cannot separate that skill from recall, unstated scoring rules or shortcut policies. We introduce Openhagen Worlds, a suite of 27 procedurally generated environments (some with finite truth spaces), from classic puzzles of experimental reasoning to simulator-grounded physics and chemistry, in which an agent runs experiments under a budget and commits an answer that a deterministic verifier checks against a hidden truth. Every observation states the complete scoring rule, and each of the 178 difficulty levels is calibrated: it is admitted only if, on 64 development instances, a scripted oracle succeeds on at least 0.75, the strongest plausible non-deductive policy on at most 0.25 and each gated shortcut on at most 0.35. The 92 core levels span all 27 families and are sized to train small models; the 86 frontier rungs extend the 15 discovery worlds with harder questions and with campaigns of three, five and eight or more committed stages on one hidden system. On the same 84 withheld frontier instances, one per family and rung, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash solves 32 at its default reasoning effort with 16,384 tokens per call and 57 at its maximum effort with up to 393,216 tokens per call (oracle: 79); the headroom that remains is largest in eight-stage campaigns. On-policy expert iteration gives a 9B model modest gains: its core-tier success on trained families rises from 0.090 to 0.148, partly through better action format, with no detectable loss on GPQA Diamond. A hosted service plays the core tier's withheld instances.

arxiv.titleZh: Openhagen Worlds:用于测量与训练科学发现智能体的校准环境

arxiv.title: Depth Before Breadth: Reverse-to-Forward Curriculum with Advantage Decomposition for LLM Agent
arxiv.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a common approach for training large language model (LLM) agents on long-horizon tasks. However, learning from sparse terminal rewards makes credit assignment and exploration difficult. We approach these challenges through a policy-induced capability region, the set of states from which the current policy can reliably complete a task. Near its boundary, an agent may need only a few actions to reach a more solvable state, even when the goal remains distant. This reduces long-horizon learning to two coupled subproblems of reaching that state and completing the task from there. We address them with paired advantages and a progressive reverse-to-forward curriculum. The advantages provide separate signals for reaching more solvable states and completing the task from them, while the curriculum expands the capability region backward along successful reference trajectories and then into off-reference states through on-policy exploration. On ALFWorld and WebShop, our method outperforms competitive agentic RL methods at both model scales, achieving success rates of 90.1%/96.1% and 80.2%/82.6% with Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B-Instruct, respectively.
arxiv.titleZh: 深度先于广度：面向 LLM Agent 的反向到正向课程与优势分解
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对长程 LLM Agent 训练中稀疏终端奖励导致的信用分配与探索困难，以策略诱导的能力区域为视角，把长程任务拆成「先到达更易求解的状态」与「从该状态完成任务」两个耦合子问题：用配对优势为两个子目标提供独立信号，并用渐进式反向到正向课程，先沿成功参考轨迹向后退扩展能力区域，再经 on-policy 探索扩展到参考轨迹之外的状态。在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 上，Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B-Instruct 成功率分别达 90.1%/96.1% 与 80.2%/82.6%，优于同类 agentic RL 方法。
arxiv.reason: Agentic RL 的课程学习与优势分解，方法新颖、结果扎实

arxiv.title: CurvDelta: Low-Curvature Delta Modeling For Surgical Learning and Unlearning
arxiv.abstract: A central challenge in adapting large language models (LLMs) is capability preservation: an adaptation can achieve its target while degrading general capabilities. We introduce CurvDelta, a scalable framework that incorporates the preservation constraint into the parameterization of the model update. By analyzing the local geometry of the preservation constraint around the pre-adaptation model, CurvDelta constructs a low-curvature space in which parameter updates leave the preservation loss nearly invariant. We make its construction practical for LLMs through Kronecker-factored approximate curvature (K-FAC) and a factorized projection. We also introduce CurvLoRA, a low-rank variant within the same preservation geometry, designed for more efficient adaptation. Both methods apply to preservation-constrained adaptation tasks such as capability learning and selective unlearning. We evaluate our methods on mathematical reasoning, code generation, and knowledge unlearning. For mathematical reasoning and code generation, our approaches achieve competitive downstream performance while better preserving general capabilities, offering a favorable acquisition--retention trade-off relative to the baselines. For knowledge unlearning, our main results on TOFU and MUSE show a better balance between targeted forgetting and knowledge retention than the baselines, with retention performance close to the from-scratch retraining reference.
arxiv.titleZh: CurvDelta：面向精准学习与遗忘的低曲率增量建模
arxiv.summaryZh: 解决 LLM 适配中的能力保持问题：适配达成目标的同时可能损害通用能力。CurvDelta 把保持约束写进参数化本身，通过分析保持损失在适配前模型附近的局部几何，构造出一个参数更新几乎不改变保持损失的低曲率空间，并用 K-FAC 与因子化投影让该构造对 LLM 可行，同时给出低秩变体 CurvLoRA。在数学推理、代码生成与知识遗忘（TOFU、MUSE）上，下游性能与基线相当而通用能力保持更好，遗忘任务上保持性能接近从头重训参考。
arxiv.reason: 保持约束参数化的适配与遗忘方法，直接命中后训练方向

arxiv.title: Piccolo: Co-Evolving Decision Models and Data through Recursive Self-Improvement
arxiv.abstract: We present Piccolo, a family of multimodal decision models (0.8B to 27B) that coevolves model capabilities and training data via Agentic Data Engineering and recursive self-improvement (RSI). The models predict probabilities over candidate answers for general-purpose text and visual judgments, agent harnesses, data workflows, and interactive games. Piccolo-27B tops the Decision Index Vision Full leaderboard with a score of 75.59, while Piccolo-9B and Piccolo-4B achieve 68.35 and 67.46, respectively. All three rank first on the Private benchmark in their respective model-size categories. Research agents analyze model behavior, construct training data, conduct experiments, and use the results to refine subsequent proposals. Semantic slices and a shared research memory connect these actions across the model family's development. With training recipes comprising hundreds of thousands of examples, data selection and feedback-driven refinement are central to the self-improvement process. Our large-scale RSI exploration yields three counter-intuitive insights for decision-model development: (1) Backbone-recipe co-adaptation outweighs raw model recency: earlier backbones can surpass newer generations on visual tasks under identical recipes; (2) Targeted data curation enables 4B-9B models to rival 27B baselines on specialized workflows; and (3) Continuous loss reduction can decouple from and even degrade discrete decision accuracy. Together with the released weights and tools from the Data-Juicer and AgentScope ecosystems, Piccolo provides an actionable blueprint for building frontier decision models and scaling data-driven RSI.

arxiv.title: Chain-of-Thought Hidden States Reveal Task-Solving Directions for Direct Answers
arxiv.abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting improves the performance of Large Language Models by eliciting intermediate reasoning steps. However, CoT is far from perfect: on some tasks, models perform worse than with direct-answer prompting, and on others they generate a few hundred tokens to reach the correct answer. We start by labelling each CoT hidden state as recovering if patching it into the direct prompt yields the correct answer, and failed otherwise. A linear probe shows that the model encodes these two classes differently. We then show that the representation space of the direct prompt holds a direction for each question that leads the model, in a short generation, to the correct answer more often than CoT does. Specifically, we rotate the direct prompt's last hidden state once, before generation, towards a direction built for each question from its own recovering and failed states. Across 25 tasks, these directions raise the direct prompt's mean accuracy from $46\%$ to $85\%$ on LLaMA 3.1 8B (CoT: $69\%$) and from $52\%$ to $86\%$ on Qwen 2.5 7B (CoT: $77\%$), with a tenth of CoT's tokens. CoT is thus not the shortest route to this accuracy, and these directions can be used in future work to train models to align their states with them.
arxiv.titleZh: 思维链隐藏状态揭示直接作答的任务求解方向
arxiv.summaryZh: 将CoT隐藏状态按「修补进直接作答提示后能否得到正确答案」分为恢复态与失败态，线性探针显示模型对两类状态编码不同;进而针对每个问题，用其自身的恢复态与失败态在直接提示的表征空间中构造一个方向，生成前将直接提示的末位隐藏状态朝该方向旋转一次。在25个任务上，LLaMA 3.1 8B平均准确率由46%升至85%(CoT为69%),Qwen 2.5 7B由52%升至86%(CoT为77%)，且仅消耗CoT约十分之一的token。这表明CoT并非达到该精度的最短路径，所得方向可用于后续训练，使模型状态与之对齐。
arxiv.reason: LLM推理机制与后训练对齐方向，方法新颖且有扎实多任务数据

arxiv.title: Late Entry in Looped Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Looped language models deepen reasoning at a compact parameter count by iterating a shared layer stack T times per token, turning recurrence depth directly into sequential decoding latency. Conventional early-exit decoding halts after initial passes without cache completion, truncating cached key-value states of past tokens to shallow depth. We study the opposite strategy, late entry, where new tokens skip initial passes and enter directly into the final K < T passes over a deep context cache. Once lightweight fine-tuning resolves hidden-state norm mismatch at the entry boundary, deep cached context substitutes for skipped token-local passes, allowing late entry to outperform matched early exit across model families and pass budgets. To turn this asymmetry into wall-clock speedups without stalling to build deep caches, candidate blocks verify through only the final K passes on the critical path while previously committed tokens complete passes 1 -> T alongside subsequent steps at zero extra serial calls. Projecting these finished T-pass wake states inside the existing output GEMM (Wake verification, governed by logit-margin tolerance tau in [0, inf]) unifies greedy-exact T-pass decoding (tau = 0, matching K = T block decoding within bf16 reduction order), margin-gated verification (tau > 0), and non-rollback lossy late entry (tau = inf) inside a single static CUDA graph. On Ouro-2.6B (T = 4), K = 2 Wake reaches 5.2x greedy-exact speedup at tau = 0 (+26% over K = 4 block decoding on GSM8K) and 6.8x at tau = inf (+16.9 points over trained early exit at matched speed). Scaling test-time recurrence across T in {8, 16, 32, 64} on Huginn-3.5B cuts K = T/4 rollbacks 21.5x with depth, driving greedy-exact (tau = 0) speedups to 6.1x (T = 32) and 8.4x (T = 64, +153% over K = 64 block) and tau = inf speedups to 10.6 to 12.5x.
arxiv.titleZh: 循环语言模型中的晚进入解码
arxiv.summaryZh: 循环语言模型每 token 迭代 T 次共享层栈，递推深度直接变成解码延迟，而常规 early exit 在前几遍即停止，缓存 KV 只到浅层。工作反向提出 late entry：新 token 跳过前几遍直接进入最后 K 遍，用深缓存上下文替代被跳过的 token 局部计算，轻量微调即可消除入口边界隐状态范数失配，并在匹配 pass 预算下胜过 early exit。实现上候选块只在关键路径跑最后 K 遍，已提交 token 的 1→T 遍与后续步骤并行补完、零额外串行调用，完成态在既有输出 GEMM 内投影，并以 logit-margin 容差 τ 把精确（τ=0）、门控验证与无回滚有损（τ=inf）解码统一进单个静态 CUDA graph。Ouro-2.6B（T=4）上 K=2 取得 5.2x 精确加速，τ=inf 时 6.8x 且比训练过的 early exit 高 16.9 分；Huginn-3.5B 在 T=64 时精确 8.4x、有损 10.6–12.5x。
arxiv.reason: 循环 LM 推理加速，新解码范式且实验数据扎实

arxiv.title: RSIBench-Infra: Can Agents Optimize Their Own Training and Inference Infrastructure at Production Scale?
arxiv.abstract: Improving the efficiency of training and inference infrastructure is a practical component of recursive self-improvement. Existing benchmarks for agent-driven optimization largely focus on individual software layers such as kernel, leaving unclear whether agents can deliver end-to-end performance gains under production workloads. We introduce RSIBench-Infra, a benchmark of 20 training and inference tasks spanning diverse model families and modalities, with deployments of up to 32 accelerators on NVIDIA GPUs and Ascend NPUs. Agents start from runnable baselines derived from official recipes and can modify the software stack across engine, kernel, and instruction levels. An OCI image-layer submission protocol captures these changes for reproducible deployment, while independent evaluation measures end-to-end performance under task-specific quality constraints. Across all task results, 66.2% exceed $1.10\times$ validated speedup. These results demonstrate that current agents can improve production-scale training and inference performance, but identifying effective optimization strategies and consistently translating local improvements into end-to-end gains remain challenging.
arxiv.titleZh: RSIBench-Infra:智能体能否在生产规模下优化自身的训练与推理基础设施?
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对智能体驱动的训练与推理基础设施优化，现有基准多局限于 kernel 等单一软件层，难以判断其在生产负载下能否带来端到端收益。RSIBench-Infra 构建了 20 个覆盖多模型家族与模态的训练/推理任务，部署规模最高达 32 卡的 NVIDIA GPU 与 Ascend NPU;智能体从官方配方得到的可运行基线出发，可在引擎、kernel 与指令层面修改软件栈，并以 OCI 镜像层提交协议保证部署可复现，由独立评测在任务特定质量约束下测量端到端性能。全部任务结果中有 66.2% 超过 1.10× 的已验证加速，表明当前智能体已能在生产规模上提升性能，但识别有效优化策略、把局部改进稳定转化为端到端收益仍然困难。

arxiv.title: Reducing Inference Cost of Coding Agents with Timeout Cascades
arxiv.abstract: AI coding agents have become one of the most popular applications of large language models. Yet, agentic AI comes at the cost of a tremendous amount of GPU compute resources, which limits its profitability and its viability at scale. In this paper, we investigate whether smaller, cheaper models can cut this cost without sacrificing accuracy. We evaluate 36 popular large and small open-weight models released since 2024 on a software engineering benchmark, and find that recent small models are closing the accuracy gap compared to their large counterparts. We investigate the structure of this gap and find that the gap is highly concentrated around hard tasks that small language models fail to solve while achieving remarkably good accuracy for easy and medium complexity tasks. Following this observation, we show that by utilizing a hybrid inference strategy that tries a small model first and escalates to a large one only when needed, we can achieve up to 33% reduction in total GPU-hour costs and 16.4% on all tasks from SWE-bench Verified, without sacrificing accuracy. Strikingly, this simple cascade nearly matches an oracle-style task router, highlighting a practical path for deploying cost-aware coding agents in production without complex learned task routers and with minimal engineering complexity.
arxiv.titleZh: 用超时级联降低编程智能体的推理成本
arxiv.summaryZh: 编程智能体的推理开销限制了其规模化部署。该工作在 SWE-bench 类软件工程基准上评测了 2024 年以来发布的 36 个开源大、小模型，发现近期小模型与同系列大模型的准确率差距主要集中在困难任务上，而在简单和中等难度任务上准确率已相当接近。基于此，作者提出一种级联推理策略：先由小模型尝试，仅在超时或失败时才升级到大模型。该策略在 SWE-bench Verified 上于不损失准确率的前提下将总 GPU 小时成本降低最多 33%，全任务平均降低 16.4%，效果接近 oracle 式任务路由器，说明无需复杂学习型路由即可实现成本感知的编程智能体部署。
arxiv.reason: 编程智能体成本优化，级联路由机制扎实且有实测数据

arxiv.title: OpenKAGE: Open-Ended Lifelong Learning in the Open World via Knowledge-Sharing Agent-Group Evolution
arxiv.abstract: Building autonomous agents that continually explore open worlds and acquire new capabilities through experience is a long-standing aspiration in artificial intelligence. Existing research often pursues lifelong learning within predefined tasks, curricula, or objectives, with self-improvement largely confined to individual agents. We introduce OpenKAGE, an agent-group evolution framework for open-ended lifelong learning. Within this framework, agents autonomously explore open worlds and continually acquire new capabilities by accumulating and reusing knowledge from their own interactions and the experience of others. OpenKAGE builds on two key mechanisms: (1) a two-layer knowledge representation, with a memory layer for situated memories and an experience layer for transferable experience and skills that retains the applicability conditions needed for reuse; and (2) a knowledge-sharing mechanism that semantically consolidates textual experience into a continuously evolving shared knowledge graph, while executable skills are shared verbatim. In Minecraft, OpenKAGE supports open-ended lifelong learning, enabling agent groups to sustain exploration and reach advanced technological milestones. Furthermore, the accumulated knowledge can be transferred to a newly initialized agent group on a different backbone model, improving its survival and exploration progress.
arxiv.titleZh: OpenKAGE：通过知识共享的智能体群体演化实现开放世界中的开放式终身学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对终身学习多局限于预定义任务与课程、自我改进基本局限于单个智能体的问题，提出一种智能体群体演化框架：双层知识表示把情境记忆与可迁移经验分开，经验层显式保留技能复用所需的适用条件；知识共享机制将文本经验语义归并为持续演化的共享知识图谱，而可执行技能则原样共享。在 Minecraft 中，该框架支撑开放式终身学习，使智能体群体维持长期探索并达成高级科技里程碑；积累的知识迁移到换用不同基座模型的新初始化群体后，其生存能力与探索进度均得到提升。
arxiv.reason: 智能体群体自进化与知识共享机制，直接命中 Agent 与自我改进方向

arxiv.title: LoopCache: Accelerating Long-Context Self-Speculative Decoding for Looped Transformers
arxiv.abstract: Looped Transformers achieve large effective depth with compact models by repeatedly applying a weight-shared block across R recurrent steps, each maintaining a loop-specific key-value (KV) cache. To accelerate sequential loop execution, recent wave-style self-speculative methods like WaveFront Decoding (WFD) and LoopSpec pipeline draft and target tokens across loops in a single step. However, they face two critical limitations. First, they draft only at fixed loops and ignore intermediate prediction changes, wasting computation on stale trajectories. Second, batching tokens from different loops loads up to Rx the KV cache per step, severely amplifying memory traffic in long-context scenarios. To address these challenges, we propose LoopCache, an efficient self-speculative decoding framework for long-context Looped Transformers. Based on the correlation between prediction switches and output confidence, LoopCache introduces confidence-guided dynamic draft updating to refine drafts in flight across all intermediate loops. Furthermore, LoopCache employs a cyclic loop KV cache strategy that rotates through loop-specific KV caches, restricting per-step KV traffic to a single loop while batching tokens at the nearest matching cycle for lossless verification. By also selectively retaining independent KV caches for a few loop-sensitive shallow layers, LoopCache improves acceptance rates with negligible overhead. Experiments show that LoopCache achieves average 10.25x and 14.56x speedup over WFD and LoopSpec.
arxiv.titleZh: LoopCache:加速循环 Transformer 的长上下文自推测解码
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对循环 Transformer 长上下文自推测解码的两个瓶颈——仅在固定循环处起草、浪费算力在陈旧轨迹上，以及跨循环批处理 token 使每步 KV cache 读取量最高放大 R 倍——提出 LoopCache 框架。依据预测切换与输出置信度的相关性，在所有中间循环上动态更新草稿;采用循环轮转的 loop-specific KV cache 策略，把每步 KV 流量限制在单个循环内，并在最近匹配周期上批处理 token 以无损验证;对少量对循环敏感的浅层保留独立 KV cache，以极小开销提升接受率。相对 WFD 与 LoopSpec 平均取得 10.25 倍与 14.56 倍加速。
arxiv.reason: 循环 Transformer 投机解码与 KV cache 优化，直接命中架构与推理效率方向

arxiv.title: 3D GameDev Arena: Benchmarking Coding Agents That Plan, Build, and Playtest extreme Long-Horizon Browser Games
arxiv.abstract: Coding agents now resolve repository issues and generate compact playable games, but whether they can build a large 3D game from scratch remains open. Such games tightly couple mechanics, scenes, assets, and interaction logic, and their quality rests on player enjoyment, which existing benchmarks rarely assess. Thus, we introduce 3D GameDev Arena, a first extreme long-horizon benchmark of 108 from-scratch game-development tasks across 14 genres. Given only a text specification and UI/UX reference images, a fully automated plan--implement--test--repair pipeline builds each task into a self-contained browser game. Runs average $\sim$1,000 LLM calls ; the longest uses 14,407 calls, 2.13B tokens, and 608 assets. Evaluation spans (1) objective code-level functional acceptance against the game specification, (2) agent-based QA and playtesting of 3D presentation and playability, and (3) blind pairwise Bradley-Terry human preference in a public arena. The preliminary findings indicate that long-horizon 3D game development remains far from solved, and code-level correctness alone does not dictate player preference. The public arena is hosted online.
arxiv.titleZh: 3D GameDev Arena:基准测试能规划、构建并试玩超长时程浏览器游戏的编码智能体
arxiv.summaryZh: 编码智能体已能修复仓库issue、生成小型可玩游戏，但从零构建完整3D游戏仍未验证:机制、场景、资产与交互逻辑紧耦合，质量取决于玩家体验。3D GameDev Arena覆盖14个品类、108个从零开发任务，仅给文本规格与UI/UX参考图，由全自动plan–implement–test–repair流水线产出浏览器游戏，平均约1,000次LLM调用，最长14,407次调用、2.13B token、608个资产。评测结合代码级功能验收、agent驱动的3D表现与可玩性试玩、公开竞技场的盲评Bradley-Terry人类偏好;结果显示长时程3D游戏开发远未解决，代码正确性并不决定玩家偏好。
arxiv.reason: 长时程编码Agent基准，含自动构建与人类偏好评测

arxiv.title: Test-Time Symmetrization: Scaling Laws for Model-Agnostic Learning under Structure
arxiv.abstract: Test-time compute has emerged as a powerful way to improve the accuracy of language models at inference time, with scaling laws quantifying how accuracy improves with additional forward passes. Existing scaling laws, however, focus on repeated sampling from a fixed prompt, even though many tasks admit multiple equivalent representations of the same underlying problem. A graph does not depend on how its nodes are numbered, and a program does not depend on the names of its variables, yet language models can change their answers under such rewritings. In this paper, we study test-time symmetrization, which uses forward passes on rewritings of the input and aggregates the resulting answers over the group $G$ of rewritings. We prove that no amount of sampling and repeated decoding from a single representation can replace rewriting, while only $O(\log |G|)$ random rewritings suffice to recover the information provided by all $|G|$ rewritings. The same set of $O(\log |G|)$ rewritings provides simultaneous approximation across models, decoding rules, and sampled reasoning traces, and the logarithmic scaling is optimal in general. We validate the theory with experiments on Qwen2.5-7B, Phi-4-mini, Llama-3.1-8B, and Qwen2.5-14B, with chain-of-thought reasoning, on graph reasoning, logical deduction, and multiple-choice question answering. At the same number of forward passes, spending them on rewritings of the input is substantially more accurate than spending them on repeated sampling from the original prompt whenever the model's answer depends on how the input is written, and the number of rewritings needed grows only logarithmically with the number of possible rewritings, as the theory predicts. Our results provide a principled way to enforce symmetries at inference time when they cannot be built into the model, which we call model-agnostic symmetrization.
arxiv.titleZh: 测试时对称化：结构化下模型无关学习的缩放定律
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有test-time scaling law只针对固定prompt重复采样，但许多任务的等价重写（如节点重新编号、变量改名）会改变模型答案。该工作提出测试时对称化：在输入重写群G上做前向并聚合答案，证明单一表示的任意重复采样都无法替代重写，而仅O(log|G|)次随机重写即可恢复全部|G|次重写的信息，且同时适用于不同模型、解码规则与推理轨迹，对数规模为最优。在Qwen2.5-7B、Phi-4-mini、Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen2.5-14B上，于图推理、逻辑演绎与多选题验证：相同前向次数下重写显著优于重复采样，所需重写数随|G|对数增长。为无法内建对称性的模型提供了在推理期施加对称性的原则性方法。
arxiv.reason: test-time scaling新范式，理论加多模型验证，直击推理期计算

arxiv.title: Rethinking Fixed-Horizon Latent Reasoning
arxiv.abstract: Existing latent reasoners typically run for a preset latent horizon during inference. Intuitively, a longer horizon should provide more opportunity for reasoning. However, in this work, we find that extending latent Chain-of-Thought (CoT) to the full preset horizon may in fact degrade reasoning performance. We observe that latent CoT evolves through distinct functional stages, with earlier computation forming frontier reasoning states, while later computation mainly reorganizes existing candidates and can weaken gold candidate support. These findings motivate a rethink of fixed-horizon latent inference. To address this, we characterize the reasoning benefits of latent CoT by realized and remaining constructive progress. Empirically, we find that higher realized constructive progress corresponds to higher current reasoning accuracy, while more remaining progress corresponds to larger future gains from continued latent CoT. To this end, we introduce a lightweight method that estimates the remaining reasoning progress and adaptively adjusts the latent horizon during inference. Across representative latent CoT reasoners and multiple arithmetic benchmarks, our method improves reasoning accuracy by up to 7.2 percentage points while reducing latent computation by up to 29.0%, without retraining the LLM.
arxiv.titleZh: 重新思考固定视界的潜在推理
arxiv.summaryZh: 潜在推理模型通常在推理时固定运行预设的latent horizon，但延长到完整视界反而可能降低准确率：前期计算形成前沿推理状态，后期计算主要重组已有候选并削弱正确候选支持。方法用已实现与剩余构造性进展刻画latent CoT的收益，轻量估计剩余推理进展并在推理时自适应调整视界，无需重训练。在多种latent CoT推理器与算术基准上，准确率最高提升7.2个百分点，latent计算量最多减少29.0%。
arxiv.reason: 潜在推理视界自适应，属推理与test-time计算高效方向，结果扎实

arxiv.title: Vanguard: Knowing When to Trust the Draft in Speculative Vision-Language Agents
arxiv.abstract: Vision-language agents that browse websites, operate phones and act in homes reason before every action, so every step waits for a large model, a latency and cost that stand in the way of deployment. Step-level speculation lets a small model draft each step and calls the large model only on rejected drafts, but its outcome rests on the judge, and a judge that reads only a step's text cannot tell whether the step fits the screen it acts on. We find that a few samples of a small model can contain a correct step about as often as the large model gets the step right, and not always on the same steps: checked against the screen, small drafts can be not only cheaper but better. We present Vanguard, a training-free judge that leaves the draft and target models unchanged: a general decision model, with the screenshot in view, gives each candidate step a probability of being right in one forward pass; the best candidate is kept if it clears a threshold, and otherwise the large model writes the step. On web, mobile and embodied agents, a 2B draft judged by Vanguard is at least as accurate as its 8B target and significantly more accurate on Mind2Web and EB-ALFRED, while the target writes only a minority of the steps; it completes far more closed-loop episodes, and with a 27B target from another family it is both faster and more accurate. Vanguard is the most accurate judge we compare on the agent tasks; it relies on the screenshot on web and mobile tasks, its calibrated threshold transfers to unseen websites, and across model families its gain over the target grows with the draft's pass@4 relative to the target's accuracy. Vanguard composes with token-level speculative decoding and matches trained process reward models on mathematics, turning speculation from a way to save the large model's work into one that can improve on it.
arxiv.titleZh: Vanguard:在投机式视觉语言 Agent 中判断何时该信任草稿
arxiv.summaryZh: 视觉语言 Agent 每步动作前都要大模型推理，延迟与成本阻碍落地;步骤级投机让小模型起草、大模型仅在草稿被拒时介入，但成败取决于判定器，而只看文本的判定器无法判断该步骤是否匹配它所操作的屏幕。Vanguard 是免训练的判定器:通用决策模型结合截图，一次前向即给出每个候选步骤正确的概率，超过阈值就采用最佳候选，否则由大模型重写。在 web、mobile 与具身 Agent 上，2B草稿经其判定后准确率不逊于8B目标模型，在 Mind2Web 与 EB-ALFRED 上显著更高，目标模型只需写少数步骤，闭环任务完成数明显更多;换用另一家族的27B目标模型时又快又准。该判定器可与 token 级投机解码组合，在数学任务上追平训练好的过程奖励模型，使投机从节省算力变为提升效果的手段。
arxiv.reason: 视觉语言 Agent 的投机判定器，效率与 Agent 双命中

arxiv.title: Kernel Ridge Attention: Nonlinear Memory with Selective Forgetting
arxiv.abstract: Kernel Ridge Attention (KRA) is a recurrent sequence mixer that combines learned nonlinear features with covariance-guided memory updates. It stores associations through recursive ridge regression, using correlations among past keys to determine how new observations modify memory. A content-dependent Ornstein--Uhlenbeck transition controls retention and restores uncertainty for future writes. This construction admits an exact temporal-kernel interpretation and maintains an inference state whose size is independent of context length. Associative block maps and explicit adjoints support parallel training while preserving the recursive update. In controlled language-modeling experiments, KRA improves prediction quality over attention and recurrent baselines, strengthens natural associative recall over the evaluated recurrent models, and achieves practical distributed training throughput. These properties provide a principled foundation for nonlinear, adaptive sequence memory.
arxiv.titleZh: Kernel Ridge Attention:带选择性遗忘的非线性记忆
arxiv.summaryZh: 循环序列混合器把可学习的非线性特征与协方差引导的记忆更新结合起来:通过递归岭回归存储关联，用过去 key 之间的相关性决定新观测应如何修改记忆;内容相关的 Ornstein–Uhlenbeck 转移负责控制记忆保留率，并为后续写入恢复不确定性。该构造具有精确的时间核解释，推理状态大小与上下文长度无关，并借助 associative block map 与显式伴随实现并行训练，同时保持递归更新语义。在受控语言建模实验中，KRA 的预测质量优于 attention 与循环基线，自然联想召回能力也强于所比较的循环模型，并达到可用的分布式训练吞吐。
arxiv.reason: 新循环序列混合器架构，理论解释与并行训练方案完整

arxiv.title: NarrowSpec: Draft Hidden Width Need Not Match the Target in Speculative Decoding
arxiv.abstract: Speculative decoding is widely used to speed up generation in large language models (LLMs), with a small draft model proposing tokens that one forward pass of the target model verifies. Draft models that read the target's hidden states, such as DFlash and EAGLE-3, typically inherit the target's hidden width. We show that the draft's whole residual stream can run at half or a quarter of that width while largely preserving acceptance. For DFlash, which borrows the target's vocabulary projection, the trained output adapter folds into it, giving one narrower projection with logits unchanged up to floating-point rounding. We test two drafter families, DFlash and EAGLE-3, on two targets, Qwen3-8B (NVFP4) and GPT-OSS-20B (MXFP4), in SGLang on a B200 and a DGX Spark (GB10). At batch size 1 and temperature 0, narrowing the draft to half or a quarter width speeds up end-to-end decoding by 1.06-1.12x on B200 and 1.13-1.44x on GB10. The speedup holds at larger batch sizes. From batch 32 to the largest batch each GPU fits, narrowing reaches up to 1.21x on both GPUs, and no narrow draft is slower than full width.
arxiv.titleZh: NarrowSpec：投机解码中草稿模型的隐藏宽度无需匹配目标模型
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 DFlash、EAGLE-3 等读取目标模型隐藏状态的草稿模型通常继承目标模型隐藏宽度的问题，发现草稿模型的整条残差流可在一半甚至四分之一宽度下运行而基本保持接受率；对借用目标词表投影的 DFlash，训练好的输出适配器可折叠进该投影，得到一个更窄且 logits 在浮点舍入误差内不变的投影。在 SGLang 中基于 Qwen3-8B（NVFP4）与 GPT-OSS-20B（MXFP4）两个目标模型、B200 与 DGX Spark 两块 GPU 上测试两族草稿模型，batch size 1、temperature 0 时端到端解码加速 1.06-1.12x（B200）与 1.13-1.44x（GB10），batch 32 以上最高达 1.21x，且无任何窄草稿慢于全宽。该结果说明草稿容量可与目标解耦，为投机解码的效率优化提供直接可用的裁剪手段。
arxiv.reason: 投机解码草稿模型宽度裁剪，命中高效推理方向且有实测加速

arxiv.title: Evidence-Based Credit Assignment for Search-Augmented Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Reinforcement learning from terminal answer rewards enables search-augmented language models to interleave reasoning and retrieval without step-level annotations, yet outcome supervision assigns identical credit to every search in a trajectory regardless of whether it retrieved useful information. This limitation is especially severe when all sampled rollouts for a question fail, collapsing group-centered outcome advantages to zero even when trajectories gather markedly different evidence. We present Evidence-based Credit Assignment (ECA), which augments terminal outcome rewards with a training-only auxiliary signal measuring how retrieved documents improve the likelihood of a reference answer. Rather than scoring the full dialogue prefix, ECA queries a frozen snapshot of the current policy under an evidence-only prompt containing solely the question and the deduplicated documents observed so far, isolating the utility of retrieved passages from surface variations in generated thoughts or search queries. Within this framework, we compare two return formulations, ECA-Step (which accumulates step-clipped potential increments) and ECA-Horizon (which preserves the telescoping horizon gain in potential), paired with cross-fold group normalization, novelty gating, and search-local token assignment. Across seven Search QA benchmarks, ECA-Horizon improves strict macro exact match over an outcome-only GRPO baseline by 1.03 and 4.80 percentage points on Qwen2.5-3B- and 7B-Instruct, respectively, outperforming both RLOO and GiGPO. Zero-shot evaluation on MultiHop-RAG further demonstrates strong transfer to multi-hop inference queries.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向搜索增强语言模型的基于证据的信用分配
arxiv.summaryZh: 搜索增强语言模型用终局答案奖励做 RL 时，轨迹中每次检索都被赋予相同信用，即使检索到的信息有用与否差别很大;当同一问题的所有采样轨迹全部失败时，分组中心化的结果优势更会整体塌缩为零。ECA 在终局结果奖励之外引入一个仅训练时使用的辅助信号，衡量检索到的文档在多大程度上提升参考答案的似然:它不评分完整对话前缀，而是用仅含问题与已去重文档的证据式 prompt 查询当前策略的冻结快照，从而把检索段落的效用与生成思维、搜索查询的表面差异隔离开。该框架下比较了 ECA-Step(累积逐步截断的势函数增量)与 ECA-Horizon(保留势函数的望远镜式全视野增益)两种回报形式，并配合交叉折分组归一化、新颖性门控与检索局部 token 分配。在七个 Search QA 基准上，ECA-Horizon 在 Qwen2.5-3B 与 7B-Instruct 上相对纯结果 GRPO 基线的严格宏平均 exact match 分别提升 1.03 与 4.80 个百分点，优于 RLOO 与 GiGPO;在 MultiHop-RAG 上的零样本评测进一步显示对多跳推理查询的良好迁移。
arxiv.reason: 搜索增强 LLM 的 Agentic RL 信用分配，方法新颖、实验扎实

arxiv.title: Thinking Fast, Anywhere: One System-1 for the Decision Points of Any Agent Workflow
arxiv.abstract: Autonomous LLM agents incur substantial cost and latency by invoking a large model (System-2) at every step, even when many intermediate actions choose among a small set of known candidates. Existing dual-system agents offload such decisions to a lightweight System-1 model, but rely on workflow-specific hooks authored per environment. We present AnyS1, a framework that turns human-authored procedural skills, whose instructions naturally specify where choices arise and which options apply, into a shared, domain-general source of decision points. Offline, AnyS1 mines grounded enumerable decisions across over 1,000 public skills, gathers execution-grounded trajectory states inside isolated containers to construct Any-DP, and trains a single calibrated 4B pointer System-1 with label smoothing. At run time, compiled workflows resolve routine decisions in one forward pass and fall back to System-2 when confidence falls below a calibrated threshold. Across three unseen benchmarks and distinct System-2 model families, AnyS1 preserves task reliability while cutting episode cost by 75-91% and model-call time by 63-92% relative to an uncompiled System-2 agent, and maintains performance under zero-shot threshold transfer.
arxiv.comment: 16 pages, 8 figures, 7 tables. Project page: https://middle-chunjie.github.io/AnyS1/
arxiv.titleZh: 快速思考，无处不在：为任意 Agent 工作流的决策点打造统一 System-1
arxiv.summaryZh: 自主 Agent 每一步都调用大模型（System-2），成本与延迟高昂，而现有双系统方案依赖为每个环境手写的接入钩子。AnyS1 把人类编写的流程性技能（其指令天然标明何处出现选择、候选有哪些）转成领域通用的决策点来源：离线从 1000 多个公开技能中挖掘可枚举的落地决策，在隔离容器内采集执行轨迹状态构成 Any-DP，训练单个带标签平滑的 4B pointer System-1；运行时编译后的工作流一次前向完成常规决策，置信度低于校准阈值即回退 System-2。在三个未见 benchmark 与不同 System-2 模型家族上，episode 成本降低 75–91%，模型调用时间降低 63–92%，任务可靠性保持，且零样本阈值迁移下性能稳定。
arxiv.reason: Agent 双系统效率优化，离线挖掘加校准回退，系统完整

arxiv.title: Ground, Iterate, Trace: Decomposing AI Research Ideation
arxiv.abstract: Large language models have been widely used to generate plausible research ideas, yet it remains unclear what makes automated ideation effective and how generated novel proposals arise from prior scientific work. We introduce the Creative AI Researcher (CAR), an agentic framework combining literature grounding, iterative development and explicit conceptual operators. CAR constructs a semantic knowledge graph from retrieved literature and equips an ideation agent with graph-retrieval tools and four operators: bisociation, analogy, exploration and elaboration. Each operator call is checked against structural acceptance conditions and recorded, producing a trace of intermediate transformations and declared literature sources. We evaluate CAR with two language-model backbones across 40 LiveIdeaBench research topics and two execution benchmarks. CAR achieves significantly higher methodological novelty (MN) than single-shot prompting and The AI Scientist. Its methodological novelty does not differ significantly from the Research Ideation Agent, while its feasibility scores are higher on both backbones. With a shared experiment executor, CAR achieves the highest pairwise win rate among the evaluated AI methods on FML-bench-Lite and BioXArena. In a ten-condition ablation study, MN point estimates favor CAR over one-step proposal on both backbones, but no MN contrast survives correction for multiple comparisons. The results do not establish a consistent quality benefit from explicit operators beyond free-form iteration. CAR makes the sequence of operations and declared literature sources inspectable, separating judged idea quality from procedural traceability.
arxiv.titleZh: Ground、Iterate、Trace：拆解 AI 研究创意生成
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 LLM 生成科研想法时何以致效、新颖提案如何从既有文献产生尚不明确的问题，提出智能体框架 CAR：从检索文献构建语义知识图谱，配以图检索工具与 bisociation、analogy、exploration、elaboration 四个概念算子迭代生成创意，每次算子调用经结构接受条件校验并记录，形成含中间变换与文献来源的可查轨迹。在 40 个 LiveIdeaBench 主题与两种模型骨干上，方法新颖性显著高于单次提示与 The AI Scientist，可行性高于 Research Ideation Agent，在 FML-bench-Lite 与 BioXArena 成对胜率最高。十条件消融中 MN 点估计占优，但多重比较校正后均不显著，显式算子相对自由迭代无稳定质量增益；其贡献在于把过程可追溯性与创意质量分开评估。
arxiv.reason: AI for Research 科研智能体框架，实验与消融系统完整

arxiv.title: Transferring an analysis of human brain organization to language models
arxiv.abstract: During human cortical development, functional systems become increasingly differentiated. We asked whether improved reasoning in language models involves a comparable regional reorganization. Applying diffusion-map embedding, used to characterize cortical organization, to matched base and reasoning-trained models from three families, we found broadly preserved gradient profiles with localized changes within a contiguous layer span. Grafting weights from these spans into instruction-tuned hosts improved mathematical reasoning on average, with gains rising with region overlap, while retaining more previously solved problems than grafts elsewhere. Across training, the span formed gradually during the early rise in performance, and grafts from intermediate stages helped. Grafts shifted most hosts partly towards their donors' behaviour and sometimes improved on problems the donors failed; the same analysis located a transferable span in a medical model. Together, these findings identify a reasoning-related region whose weights improve reasoning with low interference in the host's existing mathematical competence.
arxiv.comment: 5 figures, 5 extended data figures, 5 extended data tables; includes Supplementary Information
arxiv.titleZh: 将人脑组织分析迁移到语言模型
arxiv.summaryZh: 推理训练是否会在语言模型内部带来类似人脑皮层功能分化的区域重组？把用于刻画皮层组织的 diffusion-map embedding 应用于三个模型家族中 base 模型与推理训练模型的配对比较，发现梯度剖面大体保留，变化集中于一段连续的层区间；将该区间权重移植到指令微调宿主模型后，数学推理平均提升，提升幅度随区域重叠度增加，且比移植其他区域保留更多原先已解出的题目。该区间在训练早期的性能爬升过程中逐步形成，取自中间阶段的移植同样有效，同一分析在医学模型中也定位到可迁移区间，表明存在一个与推理相关、可低干扰迁移的权重区域。
arxiv.reason: 推理训练的权重空间分析与跨模型移植，命中后训练方向

arxiv.title: Think Offline, Act in Real Time: Self-Improving Visual Game Agents through Code
arxiv.abstract: Pre-trained models can read screens and reason about games, yet on an unfamiliar game, an agent still has to learn to play. We ask how an agent can self-improve on such a game from a few of its own attempts, in real-time visual games where the agent sees only the screen and the game keeps running while the agent thinks. We study two kinds of policy that can carry this improvement. In model as policy, a model selects actions during play; we adapt real-time chunking so that committed actions keep executing while the model reasons, and train a 2B controller for this interface. In code as policy, a model writes, tests, and revises a program between attempts, and the program acts during play. Across 170 GameWorld tasks, with at most eight one-minute executions per run, code as policy reaches 47.80% mean progress, against 30.90% for our trained controller, and leads in all five game categories. Improving the controller's weights on a single game, by contrast, yields only modest gains. These results favor letting a model think offline and storing what it learns in a program that acts in real time. Project repository: https://github.com/TabibitoQZP/SIGame
arxiv.titleZh: 离线思考，实时行动:通过代码实现自我改进的视觉游戏智能体
arxiv.summaryZh: 在只能看到屏幕、且思考时游戏仍在继续的实时视觉游戏中，智能体需要在仅有数次自身尝试的条件下实现自我改进。工作对比两类可承载改进的策略:模型即策略(model as policy)采用适配的实时分块，使已提交动作在模型推理期间继续执行，并为此训练一个 2B 控制器;代码即策略(code as policy)由模型在回合之间编写、测试与修订程序，由程序在游戏过程中实时行动。在 170 个 GameWorld 任务上、每次运行最多八次一分钟执行，code as policy 达到 47.80% 平均进度，优于训练控制器的 30.90%，并在全部五类游戏中领先;而仅在单一游戏上更新控制器权重收益有限。结果支持让模型离线思考、把习得知识固化为程序并在实时执行中落地。
arxiv.reason: 代码即策略驱动游戏自我改进，命中 Agent 与自进化方向

arxiv.title: Resolution as Attention for Efficient Agent Memory Perception
arxiv.abstract: LLM-based agents accumulate extensive interaction histories when solving complex, long-horizon tasks, making efficient memory management critical to their performance and scalability. While existing memory management methods primarily focus on what to retain or retrieve, they often overlook how much perceptual detail should be allocated to individual past interactions. We posit that effective agent memory depends not only on the information preserved, but also on the granularity at which each past interaction is perceived. Motivated by this insight, we propose Resolution as Attention (RAA), a memory perception mechanism that uses visual resolution as a means of attention allocation across interaction histories. RAA renders past interactions as images and dynamically adjusts their resolution at every step according to their relevance to the agent's upcoming decision, preserving fine-grained information for critical interactions while reducing visual-token consumption for less relevant ones. To adaptively determine the perceptual fidelity of each interaction, we train a lightweight relevance estimator with teacher-model guidance and further optimize it to preserve the agent's decision consistency at a reduced visual-token cost. Experiments across multiple tasks and backbones show that RAA reduces token consumption by over 50% without compromising task performance. Moreover, RAA can be integrated as a plug-in perception layer with existing memory management methods, yielding further token savings and revealing adaptive perception as a complementary dimension of agent memory.
arxiv.titleZh: 分辨率即注意力：面向高效 Agent 记忆的感知机制
arxiv.summaryZh: LLM Agent 在长程任务中会积累大量交互历史，而现有记忆管理只关心保留或检索什么，忽略了每条历史应分配多少感知细节。RAA 把历史交互渲染成图像，以视觉分辨率作为注意力分配手段，按与下一步决策的相关性动态调整各条历史的清晰度：关键交互保留细粒度信息，弱相关交互大幅压缩视觉 token。轻量相关性估计器由教师模型引导训练，并以保持决策一致性为目标在更低 token 成本下进一步优化。多任务、多骨干实验显示，token 消耗降低 50% 以上而任务性能不降，且该模块可作为插件接入现有记忆管理方法，带来额外节省。
arxiv.reason: Agent 记忆 + 感知粒度新视角，插件式方法，实验扎实

arxiv.title: Benchmarking LLM abilities on postdoc-level natural science problems
arxiv.abstract: Scientific problems have no answer key, so evaluating an agent means deciding what counts as a better solution before any agent is run. Existing benchmarks either match a symbolic answer against a key or, where they require executable work, score it by unit tests, by a rubric, or by position on a competition leaderboard. None of these is the criterion by which a field decides that one published method beats another. STEMBench adopts that criterion directly. Each of its twelve research problems in high-energy physics, astrophysics and neuroscience is scored by its own field's figure of merit, and each comes with two measured anchors: a submission that uses no domain knowledge, and an expert reference reproducing a published method, both obtained by running code shipped with the benchmark. The interval between them states how much of a problem is crossed by scientific insight rather than by engineering. Across eight frontier models, task-level wins and domain-level leadership dissociate: a model that wins five of the twelve tasks leads no domain mean. In the high-effort cross-model comparison, at least one model's mean score exceeds the expert anchor on seven of twelve tasks. The remaining five span uncertainty estimation, latent and causal inference, and cross-site clinical classification. Numerical scores and official-submission validity capture different aspects of performance and are reported separately. We release the tasks, graders, anchors and harness.
arxiv.titleZh: 评估LLM在博士后级自然科学问题上的能力基准
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有基准要么匹配符号答案，要么用单元测试或评分规则，无法反映领域判定方法优劣的标准。STEMBench直接采用各领域自身的品质因数，为12个高能物理、天体物理和神经科学问题分别设置无领域知识与专家参考两个锚点，锚点通过运行基准自带代码获得。评估八个前沿模型发现，任务级胜利与领域级领先分离，高努力比较中至少一个模型在七个任务上平均分超过专家锚点，剩余五个任务涉及不确定性估计、潜在与因果推断及跨站点临床分类。该基准发布了任务、评分器、锚点和运行框架，为评估LLM的科学洞察与工程能力提供了可复现的标准化手段。
arxiv.reason: 评测方法学创新，锚点设计有参考价值，但领域偏自然科学

arxiv.title: Space-X: Self-Evolving Spatial Agents Weaving Clues into Evidence Chains
arxiv.abstract: Spatial reasoning connects visual observations, geometric estimates, and linguistic decisions into a coherent derivation. Yet tool-augmented agents often acquire evidence without clear targets, combine outputs under inconsistent object or reference-frame semantics, and misjudge evidence sufficiency. Thus, more tools or calls do not reliably improve reasoning. We introduce Space-X, a spatial-reasoning framework that self-evolves toward complete, continuous evidence-chain construction. An Execution Agent acquires, associates, and judges evidence per problem using role-specific memory. A Control Agent diagnoses evidence-chain breaks from execution traces and jointly revises tools, interfaces, skills, memory organization, and decision rules. This loop co-evolves capability and evidence use: evidence needs guide capability development; usable results guide actions. Across multiple benchmarks, Space-X yields gains with four base models. Relative to baselines, GPT-6-sol improves answer accuracy on ViewSpatial and MMSI by 50.39% and 23.07%, respectively; Gemini-3.8-Flash gains 47.50% and 25.22% on these benchmarks. This provides a unified route from fragmented spatial clues to traceable, derivable answers.
arxiv.titleZh: Space-X：将线索编织为证据链的自演化空间智能体
arxiv.summaryZh: 工具增强智能体在空间推理中常常无明确目标地取证，输出在对象与参考系语义上不一致，并误判证据是否充分，因此增加工具或调用次数并不能稳定提升推理质量。Space-X 让执行智能体借助角色专用记忆完成证据的获取、关联与充分性判断，再由控制智能体从执行轨迹中诊断证据链断裂，并联合修订工具、接口、技能、记忆组织与决策规则，使能力与证据使用协同演化。在多个基准与四个基座模型上均取得提升：GPT-6-sol 在 ViewSpatial 与 MMSI 上的答案准确率分别提升 50.39% 与 23.07%，Gemini-3.8-Flash 分别提升 47.50% 与 25.22%，为从碎片化空间线索走向可追溯、可推导的答案提供了统一路径。
arxiv.reason: 自演化空间智能体，命中 Agent 与自我改进方向

arxiv.title: MLE Agents: Autonomous ML Engineering in Large-scale Recommendation Systems
arxiv.abstract: The typical workflow for improving large-scale ranking and recommendation models is slow and tedious: an engineer forms a hypothesis, implements it as a code change, trains a model, and evaluates it both offline and online, often relying on their own intuition and experience along the way. Autonomous LLM agents promise to speed this up by running the loop on their own, but it is still unclear whether they can do this in industry-scale systems rather than on benchmarks or small proxy tasks. We build human-on-the-loop machine learning engineer (MLE) agents that propose, implement, train, and evaluate model changes on large-scale search rankers. Engineers retain control over objective design, search direction, and final-model review. We identify three obstacles that make this industry setting challenging: feedback takes hours per experiment, offline metrics do not always predict online impact, and improvements saturate after the early wins. We address these with parallel training runs, an objective calibrated to match online impact, and careful context engineering. In one campaign, the system ran 1,097 completed candidate experiments and accepted 325, a 29.6\% acceptance rate compared with 15.6\% in the earlier campaign under a different objective and search constraint. Its best model increases search volume by 0.23\% in an A/B test of large scale. Several improvements were architectural changes the team had never tried, drawn from the broader industry and literature, suggesting that MLE agents can explore regions of the design space that human intuition overlooks. We find that the design of the harness around the model matters: intuition suggests that a stronger underlying model is enough, but in our experience, the design of the loop around it is just as critical. More broadly, our work shows that autonomous agents can do real machine-learning engineering in industry-scale systems.
arxiv.titleZh: MLE Agents：大规模推荐系统中的自主机器学习工程
arxiv.summaryZh: 面向工业级搜索排序模型迭代慢、依赖工程师直觉的问题，构建人机协同（human-on-the-loop）的 MLE agent，让其自主完成假设提出、代码实现、训练与离线/在线评估，工程师保留目标设计、搜索方向与最终模型评审权。针对单次实验反馈耗时数小时、离线指标难以预测线上收益、早期收益后迅速饱和三大障碍，采用并行训练、与线上影响校准的目标函数以及精细的上下文工程。一次 campaign 完成 1097 个候选实验并接受 325 个，接受率 29.6%（此前为 15.6%），最佳模型在大规模 A/B 测试中提升搜索量 0.23%，且部分收益来自团队从未尝试的架构改动。结论指出环绕模型的 harness 设计与基座模型强度同等关键，说明自主 agent 可在工业级系统中承担真实的 ML 工程工作。
arxiv.reason: 工业级 recsys 上的自主 MLE agent 闭环，含大规模实验数据

arxiv.title: Metrics-in-the-Loop: Complexity Feedback Reshapes Agent-Written Code
arxiv.abstract: Coding agents now write whole codebases in long autonomous runs, guided mainly by whether their tests pass. Yet passing tests alone does not reveal accumulating complexity or gaps in test coverage, which then persist as agents extend their own code. We introduce metrics-in-the-loop, an inference-time intervention that gives agents in-flight feedback: cheap, automatically computed code metrics injected into the agent's context during the trajectory. After each code-changing agent turn, we insert short feedback messages naming changed functions whose cyclomatic complexity exceeds a limit (complexity feedback) or changed lines that are skipped by tests (coverage feedback), giving the agent the opportunity to refactor code or strengthen tests before continuing. We run extensive experiments and ablations comparing several interventions across three long-horizon coding benchmarks and four strong models. We find that complexity feedback significantly reduces erosion, a measure of complexity concentration of code, without affecting held-out correctness of the code. Broadly, our experiments investigate a practical form of agent "re-railing", where timely, actionable measurements redirect agents before weaknesses become the foundation they keep building on. As agents scale to codebases with millions of lines, such interventions become critical to sustaining effective development and long-term code maintainability.
arxiv.comment: Agent Evaluation Science Symposium, Fall 2026, New York City
arxiv.titleZh: Metrics-in-the-Loop：复杂度反馈重塑 Agent 编写的代码
arxiv.summaryZh: 编码 Agent 在长程自主运行中主要以测试是否通过为导向，但测试通过并不反映复杂度累积与测试覆盖缺口，这些缺陷会随 Agent 继续扩展自身代码而固化。为此提出 metrics-in-the-loop：在推理阶段于每轮改码后自动计算廉价代码指标，并把「圈复杂度超限的改动函数」或「未被测试覆盖的改动行」以短消息注入 Agent 上下文，使其有机会先重构或补测试再继续。在三个长程编码 benchmark 与四个强模型上做了多种干预与消融对比，复杂度反馈显著降低代码复杂度集中的「侵蚀」指标且不损害留出集正确性。该工作给出一种实用的 Agent「重新扶轨」机制，面向百万行级代码库的可维护性开发。
arxiv.reason: Agent 编码 harness 的推理期干预，方向对口且实验扎实

arxiv.title: Choosing What to Observe: Budget-Paired Counterfactual Audits for Credible Evaluation of Visual Agents
arxiv.abstract: Visual agents that read dense documents must ration a finite observation budget across candidate regions, yet answer accuracy conflates where an agent looks, how it adapts to the reads that remain, and how it an?swers once observation stops. We introduce budget-paired counterfactual audits, an evaluation protocol that holds public evidence and region bindings fixed while perturbing only the remaining budget or de?clared task parameters, and credits every acquired history with exact continuation values. The resulting accounting decomposes lost expected accuracy into stepwise acquisition loss and terminal decision loss, separating planning from fixed-role heuristics.
