arxiv.titleZh: 选择观察什么：面向视觉Agent可信评估的预算配对反事实审计
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对视觉Agent在阅读密集文档时需在有限观察预算内分配候选区域、而答案准确率混杂了观察位置、对剩余读取的适应与终止决策的问题，提出预算配对反事实审计：固定公共证据与区域绑定，仅扰动剩余预算或任务参数，并为每条已获取历史计算精确延续价值。该核算将期望准确率损失拆分为逐步获取损失与终止决策损失，从而区分规划能力与固定角色启发式。在40个配对路由锚点与五个开放权重模型上验证了该评估协议，可用于更可信地比较视觉Agent的观察策略与决策组件。
arxiv.reason: 视觉Agent评估方法学，分解观察与决策损失，方向相关

arxiv.title: Can Programs Replace LLM Judges? Executable Program Judges for Scalable and Efficient Relevance Labeling
arxiv.abstract: Large language model (LLM) judges have become a common way to create large-scale relevance judgments for retrieval evaluation. However, each judgment requires a potentially expensive call to a frontier model, and the judgments are hard to interpret and may not be reproducible. In this paper, we ask whether an LLM can write a readable program for each topic that replaces its per-document judgments. To address these issues, we propose ExecJudges, a method for generating fast, inspectable and scalable judges for automatic relevance labeling. Specifically, ExecJudges uses a frontier LLM to turn assessment guidelines into executable programs, which rely only on lexical matching, standard NLP libraries like parsers, and pool statistics. An ExecJudges-L variant also uses examples of human labels if available. We evaluate ExecJudges on seven TREC collections by comparing the produced labels with trained NIST assessors, frontier LLM judges, and recently proposed per-topic classifiers. Our results show that ExecJudges agrees with NIST assessors at the level of the Claude Sonnet 5.5 LLM judges on TREC DL 2019-2021. With a small number of human labels per topic, the ExecJudges-L variant agrees with NIST more than per-topic classifiers with the same labels on all seven collections, and either exceeds the agreement of LLM judges provided the same labels or is within about 0.05 of it in Krippendorff's alpha. The labels rank the official TREC DL runs with Kendall's tau of 0.87 to 0.94, and writing the programs incurs a one-time cost of $0.17 to $0.49 per topic, with no additional costs for grading. Our results suggest that ExecJudges offers a reproducible, inspectable, efficient and cost-effective alternative to LLM judges for labeling deep result pools for system evaluation or ranking improvements.
arxiv.titleZh: 程序能取代LLM裁判吗？用于可扩展、高效相关性标注的可执行程序裁判
arxiv.summaryZh: LLM裁判为检索评测做大规模相关性标注成本高、难复现且不易解释。ExecJudges让前沿LLM把评估指南转写成可执行程序，程序只依赖词法匹配、解析器等标准NLP库与候选池统计；ExecJudges-L变体还可利用少量人工标签。在7个TREC集合上，其标注与NIST评审员的一致度在TREC DL 2019–2021上追平Claude Sonnet级LLM裁判；在有少量人工标签时，ExecJudges-L在全部7个集合上优于同等标签的按主题分类器，与LLM裁判的Krippendorff's alpha相差约0.05以内。生成标签对官方TREC DL系统排序的Kendall's tau为0.87–0.94，编写程序的一次性成本为每主题0.17–0.49美元，后续评分不再产生费用，为系统评测与排序优化提供了可复现、可检查、低成本的LLM裁判替代方案。
arxiv.reason: LLM-as-judge的替代方案，可复现且低成本，切入评测方法学

arxiv.title: Atomic MathReasoner: Instance-Level Composition of Atomic Reasoning Skills for Mathematical LLMs
arxiv.abstract: Most existing approaches enhance mathematical reasoning in large language models (LLMs) as a monolithic capability, despite the fact that different mathematical problems require different reasoning skills. Recent work has explored a more fine-grained perspective by decomposing mathematical reasoning into atomic skills and developing specialized modules for individual capabilities. However, how to effectively utilize these atomic abilities remains underexplored. To address this challenge, we propose Atomic MathReasoner (AMR), an instance-level framework for composing atomic reasoning skills. AMR first trains a library of capability-specific LoRA experts and performs gradient-free optimization over held-out validation subsets to discover a diverse set of low-loss composition prototypes. It evaluates the preference of each prototype using the token-level negative log-likelihood of reference solutions, filters ambiguous assignments through a confidence margin, and distills the resulting pseudo-labels into a lightweight router. During inference, the router selects an appropriate composition prototype for each problem, enabling problem-specific utilization of atomic skills without costly online optimization. Experiments on the AtomicMath benchmark across general and mathematics-specialized LLMs demonstrate consistent improvements. On Qwen2.5-Math-Instruct-7B, AMR increases average field accuracy from 64.4% to 68.1% at Level 1 and from 59.3% to 63.7% at Level 2, while improving average logical reasoning performance from 39.4% to 46.8%. These results demonstrate that effectively composing specialized atomic skills provides a promising approach to strengthening mathematical reasoning in LLMs.
arxiv.titleZh: Atomic MathReasoner：面向数学 LLM 的原子推理技能实例级组合
arxiv.summaryZh: 将数学推理从单一能力视角转为按题组合原子技能：先训练一组能力专属的 LoRA 专家库，在留出验证子集上做无梯度搜索，得到低损失的组合原型；再用参考解的 token 级负对数似然评估各原型的偏好程度，以置信度边际过滤歧义样本，蒸馏出轻量路由器，推理时按题选择原型，且无需在线优化。在 AtomicMath 上，Qwen2.5-Math-Instruct-7B 的 Level 1 平均正确率由 64.4% 升至 68.1%，Level 2 由 59.3% 升至 63.7%，逻辑推理由 39.4% 升至 46.8%。这一实例级技能组合与路由思路，可迁移到其他需要多能力协同的后训练场景。
arxiv.reason: LoRA 专家组合与路由，属数学推理后训练的扎实工作

arxiv.title: Kaer: Security-Aware Replanning for Multi-Agent Systems
arxiv.abstract: One popular architecture for multi-agent systems (MAS) relies on an orchestrator that generates an initial plan, coordinates its execution, and dynamically revises the plan based on agent feedback when tasks cannot be fully specified in advance. This dynamic replanning introduces a critical vulnerability: malicious agents can embed instructions within their feedback to hijack the replanning process. Existing defenses focus exclusively on per-tool access control or static, pre-execution policy enforcement, leaving the replanning phase unsecured. We introduce Kaer, a multi-agent framework featuring security-aware replanning. Kaer shields the planner from untrusted agent feedback by conveying diagnostics to the replanning procedure strictly through abstract templates. Plan revisions are restricted to a set of deterministic repair operators, and all modified plans must satisfy preset policies. We create Cintra, a benchmark of simulated user tasks requiring replanning paired with adversarial objectives targeting the replanning phase. Using Cintra, we evaluate both task completion rates and system vulnerability to replanning exploits by malicious agents. Evaluating Kaer on Cintra against Magentic-One (an undefended MAS) and ControlValve (the state-of-the-art defense) demonstrates that Kaer achieves higher robustness than both systems while maintaining comparable utility to ControlValve. Although abstract failure templates slightly constrain utility on select tasks, Kaer enables MAS to perform secure, dynamic plan revisions without exposing the orchestrator to untrusted agent feedback.
arxiv.titleZh: Kaer:面向多智能体系统的安全感知重规划
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对编排式多智能体系统在动态重规划阶段的漏洞:恶意代理可在反馈中嵌入指令，劫持规划器的重规划过程，而现有防御只覆盖单工具访问控制或执行前的静态策略。Kaer 让诊断信息仅以抽象模板形式进入重规划流程，使规划器不接触不可信代理反馈，并把计划修改限定为一组确定性修复算子，且修改后的计划必须满足预设策略。作者同时构建 Cintra 基准，包含需要重规划的模拟用户任务与针对重规划阶段的对抗目标，并用其测任务完成率与系统被利用的脆弱性。在 Cintra 上，Kaer 的鲁棒性高于无防御的 Magentic-One 与当前最优防御 ControlValve，效用与后者相当，但抽象失败模板在部分任务上会略微限制效用。
arxiv.reason: 多智能体编排的重规划注入防御，属 Agent 安全方向，方法扎实非范式级

arxiv.title: GateWatch: Low-Overhead LLM Monitoring with Boolean Circuits
arxiv.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) and LLM-based agents are increasingly deployed, monitoring their behavior becomes important for detecting unsafe or unintended actions. Activation probes offer an efficient approach, but existing methods face trade-offs between accuracy, interpretability, and computational overhead. Probes on raw activations lack interpretable inputs, whereas sparse autoencoder (SAE) probes use interpretable features but often rely on additive classifiers and large SAE encoders, limiting interpretability and increasing memory overhead. We introduce GateWatch, a compact, interpretable classifier that expresses its entire decision rule as an explicit Boolean logic over a small number of binarized SAE features. We explore three approaches to constructing these circuits under a specified gate budget. For efficient deployment, GateWatchServe computes only selected SAE features, enables streaming of their binary values across layers during inference, and evaluates multiple GateWatch classifiers in parallel using compact lookup tables. Across 24 tasks on Gemma-2-9B, GateWatch achieves 80.49% mean test accuracy using only 3.8 SAE features and 3.5 logic gates per probe on average, just 1.17 percentage points below full 16K-feature SAE probes, while matching or outperforming them on 10 tasks and reducing probe memory by 99.98%. Inside vLLM, 1,000 concurrent multi-layer, multi-token GateWatch classifiers retain 97-98% of baseline throughput and 99.8% of KV-cache capacity.
arxiv.titleZh: GateWatch：基于布尔电路的低开销 LLM 监控
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 LLM 与 Agent 部署中的行为监控需求，激活探针在准确率、可解释性与计算开销之间难以兼顾：原始激活探针缺乏可解释输入，SAE 探针依赖加性分类器与大型编码器。GateWatch 将整个决策规则表示为少量二值化 SAE 特征上的显式布尔逻辑，并给出三种在给定门数预算下构造电路的方法；配套的 GateWatchServe 只计算被选中的 SAE 特征、在推理中跨层流式传递二值值，并用紧凑查找表并行评估多个分类器。在 Gemma-2-9B 的 24 个任务上，平均仅用 3.8 个 SAE 特征与 3.5 个逻辑门即达 80.49% 测试准确率，比全 16K 特征 SAE 探针低 1.17 个百分点，其中 10 个任务持平或更优，探针内存降低 99.98%；在 vLLM 中，1000 个并发多层多 token 分类器仍保持 97–98% 吞吐与 99.8% KV-cache 容量。
arxiv.reason: 可解释监控探针与 vLLM 部署优化结合，系统扎实但方向略偏

arxiv.title: Objective-Specialized Residual Streams in Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections
arxiv.abstract: Manifold-constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC) extend a Transformer's residual stream into multiple parallel streams with learned cross-stream connections. Prior work trains all streams toward a shared objective. We instead study whether assigning distinct learning objectives to different streams can improve task performance and induce objective-specific specialization. Using complementary lexical (sparse) and semantic (dense) retrieval objectives as a test case, we find that objective-specialized mHC consistently outperforms a non-specialized mHC model across the full sparse--dense fusion range, for both two- and four-stream models and at two model scales. We then examine how specialization changes the model internally using probes of stream representations, residual mixing, objective-specific gradient flow, and read/write gates. The specialized and non-specialized models behave similarly through most of the network but diverge in the final layers: the specialized model develops increasingly objective-specific gradient flow, distinct read/write routing patterns, and reduced cross-stream mixing, and streams assigned to different objectives become increasingly dissimilar while those trained toward the same objective remain highly similar. Fixing the residual mixing to the identity leaves the specialization benefit intact, indicating that the benefit stems from objective-specific read/write routing rather than learned cross-stream mixing. These results show that assigning distinct objectives to mHC streams can improve multi-objective retrieval while inducing structured, depth-dependent specialization in the residual computation.
arxiv.titleZh: 流形约束超连接中的目标特化残差流
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对多目标检索中所有残差流共享同一训练目标的问题，为流形约束超连接（mHC）的不同流分别分配稀疏词法检索与稠密语义检索目标。在二流与四流、两种模型规模下，目标特化mHC在整个稀疏—稠密融合区间内均优于非特化版本；探针显示差异集中在最后几层，表现为目标特化梯度流增强、读写路由分化、跨流混合减少，且固定残差混合为单位阵后收益仍保留。结果表明收益主要来自目标特化的读写路由，而非学习到的跨流混合。
arxiv.reason: Transformer残差流架构改进，机制分析扎实，属架构方向但非范式级

arxiv.title: Do Frontier Model Ingredients Add Up? A Replicated Factorial Study of Small Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Building a small language model requires choosing which published improvements to combine. We compare five changes in the same model, using the same data and training budget. We test selected combinations and repeat each one with a second random seed. Mixture-of-experts layers, Muon optimisation and a Gated DeltaNet hybrid give the largest gains. Extra normalisation also helps, while an attention gate with a matched parameter budget adds little on average. The gains mostly combine, but small interactions between changes appear again in the repeated runs. Repetition also reveals benefits that an initial statistical estimate treated as noise. These findings apply to our small-model training setting; the expert models also have greater total capacity. The practical lesson is to test promising components together and repeat the comparisons before deciding which ones to keep.
arxiv.titleZh: 前沿模型的配方能叠加吗?小语言模型的重复因子实验研究
arxiv.summaryZh: 小模型研发需要在同一模型、同一数据与算力预算下决定组合哪些已发表的改进，而各组件收益能否叠加缺少系统证据。该工作在统一设置下比较五种改动(混合专家层、Muon 优化器、Gated DeltaNet 混合架构、额外归一化、参数预算匹配的注意力门控)，测试多种组合并用第二个随机种子重复实验。结果显示 MoE、Muon 与 Gated DeltaNet 混合带来最大增益，额外归一化亦有帮助，注意力门控平均收益很小;各改动收益大体可叠加，但重复实验仍能稳定复现出小幅交互作用，并揭示初次统计估计被判为噪声的收益。结论限定于小模型训练场景(专家模型总容量更大)，实践建议是把候选组件放在一起测试并重复对比后再取舍。
arxiv.reason: 统一预算下系统对比 MoE、Muon、混合架构等预训练组件，贴合架构与训练方向

arxiv.title: OpenGNS: An Open Dataset of the Gradient Noise Scale across Vision, Language, and Diffusion Models
arxiv.abstract: The Gradient Noise Scale (GNS) metric measures the signal-to-noise ratio of gradients in stochastic gradient descent and, as shown by McCandlish et al. (2018), can be used to approximate the Critical Batch Size (CBS) during neural network training. Despite its appearance in technical reports of frontier models, no open dataset of GNS measurements across modern architectures exists, limiting systematic study of the metric. We close this gap by releasing OpenGNS, a dataset of more than 400 GNS measurement trajectories spanning three domains: image classification with ResNets, autoregressive language modeling with Generative Pre-trained Transformers (GPTs), and image synthesis with Diffusion Transformers (DiTs), covering models from 11M to 1B parameters trained under Maximal Update Parameterization (muP) with dense batch-size and learning-rate sweeps. Building on this dataset, we study how the GNS depends on hyperparameters, scale, and training progress, and how it relates to the CBS. We find that the GNS behaves as a consistent "temperature of training", remaining stable across model sizes under muP at equivalent loss, and our results suggest task-dependent biases in its relation to the CBS: a tendency to overestimate the CBS for classification and to underestimate it for generative tasks, consistent in direction across common CBS definitions. The dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/olympique-marcel/OpenGNS
arxiv.titleZh: OpenGNS:一个覆盖视觉、语言与扩散模型的梯度噪声规模开放数据集
arxiv.summaryZh: 梯度噪声规模(GNS)刻画随机梯度下降中梯度的信噪比，可用于近似临界批量大小(CBS)，但此前缺少跨现代架构的公开测量数据。OpenGNS 提供 400 余条 GNS 测量轨迹，覆盖 ResNet 图像分类、GPT 自回归语言建模与 DiT 图像生成，模型规模 11M–1B，均在 muP 参数化下训练，并做批量大小与学习率的密集扫描。基于该数据发现 GNS 在等价损失下跨模型规模保持稳定，表现为一致的「训练温度」;其与 CBS 的关系存在任务相关偏差:分类任务倾向高估 CBS，生成任务倾向低估，且方向在不同 CBS 定义下一致。该数据集可用于批量大小与学习率设定、大规模训练效率与 scaling 行为的系统研究。
arxiv.reason: 预训练训练动力学与临界批量大小的公开测量数据集，命中 scaling 与效率方向

arxiv.title: KnowledgeClaw: Towards Agentic Knowledge Engineering via Omnimodal Hypergraphs
arxiv.abstract: Knowledge engineering (KE) turns raw files into a reasoning-ready knowledge base, a task now within reach of LLM agents. KE has progressed from chunk and graph retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to memory agents, agentic KE and multimodal KE. However, a live knowledge base needs omnimodality, a closed-loop lifecycle and multi-granular application at once, yet existing systems meet at most two and no benchmark measures all three. We formalize Omnimodal Knowledge Engineering (OmniKE) and release OmniKE-Bench, six tasks with 1,829 model-free items over 3,960 real files in five modalities. We further propose KnowledgeClaw, an agentic system that builds an omnimodal typed hypergraph, keeps it current with a closed-loop lifecycle agent and routes each query to the granularity it needs. Against 30 baselines, it ranks first on all six tasks with an overall OKE of 55.9, +14.6 over the strongest baseline. Our software and data are publicly available at https://github.com/LHRLAB/KnowledgeClaw.
arxiv.titleZh: KnowledgeClaw:迈向基于全模态超图的智能体化知识工程
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有知识库系统难以同时满足全模态覆盖、闭环生命周期维护与多粒度应用这三项需求。为此，该工作形式化了全模态知识工程(OmniKE)，并发布 OmniKE-Bench:包含 6 个任务、1829 条无需模型评判的条目，覆盖 5 种模态的 3960 个真实文件。KnowledgeClaw 构建全模态类型化超图，用闭环生命周期 Agent 持续更新，并把每次查询路由到所需粒度。在与 30 个基线的对比中，它在六项任务上全部排名第一，整体 OKE 为 55.9，比最强基线高 14.6。
arxiv.reason: Agentic RAG 与记忆系统结合，含新基准与系统实现，方向扎实

arxiv.title: Learning to Coordinate: LLM-Guided Workflow Evolution for Token-Efficient Red Teaming
arxiv.abstract: Automated red teaming is essential for identifying safety failures in large language models (LLMs), but its practical scalability depends on the resources required to discover those failures. Multi-agent systems can combine complementary capabilities, yet repeated planning, redundant exchanges, and ineffective information routing can make their coordination expensive. Moreover, a target model's response indicates the outcome of a test without identifying which collaboration decision should change. We present Learning to Coordinate (L2C), an LLM-guided framework that evolves an executable multi-agent workflow for each red-teaming case. L2C represents agent responsibilities, execution dependencies, and input bindings in a versioned graph, and associates each graph with records of the information actually delivered and produced. A controller trained through supervised fine-tuning integrates these records with target responses, evaluator verdicts, and remaining budget to retain the workflow, refine instructions, restructure collaboration, or lock further editing. This design connects feedback to explicit changes in subsequent execution while allowing a useful organization to continue without repeated controller intervention. The evaluation protocol covers HarmBench with three execution backbones and two target models, together with component ablations, dataset transfer, and evaluator checks. Across the six executor-target configurations, L2C improves ASR over EvoSynth by 1.4 to 4.5 percentage points while reducing mean online tokens by 35.6% to 37.3%. L2C connects adaptive collaboration to the resource requirements of automated security evaluation.
arxiv.titleZh: 学会协同：LLM 引导的工作流演化实现 token 高效的红队测试
arxiv.summaryZh: 多智能体红队测试中重复规划、冗余交换与低效信息路由推高协调成本，而目标模型的回复只表明测试结果，并不指出应改动哪项协作决策。L2C 用带版本的图表示智能体职责、执行依赖与输入绑定，并为每个图记录实际传递与产出的信息；经监督微调训练的控制器结合这些记录、目标回复、评估判定与剩余预算，决定保留工作流、精炼指令、重构协作或锁定编辑。在 HarmBench 上覆盖三种执行骨干与两个目标模型的六种配置中，L2C 的 ASR 较 EvoSynth 提升 1.4 至 4.5 个百分点，平均在线 token 减少 35.6% 至 37.3%，把自适应协作与自动化安全评测的资源约束直接对接。
arxiv.reason: 多智能体工作流演化与 token 高效红队，命中的正是 Agent 方向

arxiv.title: A Mechanistic Analysis of In-Context Learning and Out-of-Context Hallucination
arxiv.abstract: Large language models can infer and follow specific rules through in-context learning (ICL), yet may fail to remain faithful to provided evidence, giving rise to out-of-context (OOC) hallucination. Existing work has largely investigated the underlying mechanisms of ICL and OOC hallucination along separate lines. However, this separation obscures the mechanistic basis for these seemingly opposing outcomes. In this work, we study this contrast through the unified view of functional roles in dynamic context. The key observation is that role information can be internally represented without reliably constraining output. We derive a first-order decomposition to characterize the role effect, showing that its substantial influence depends on two necessary conditions, namely sufficient contribution magnitude and coherent signed aggregation. Causal analysis further shows that role span contributions affect key token choices involving response structure, content selection, and factual values. We further show that role-consistent choices depend on sufficient role span support at these key decisions, while failing choices can be reversed when this support overcomes the deficit. These findings support a common mechanistic view of ICL and OOC hallucination: each functional role defines the pattern of output decisions over which role span contributions must remain effective, and differences in this organization account for the seemingly opposing outcomes.
arxiv.titleZh: 上下文学习与上下文外幻觉的机制分析
arxiv.summaryZh: LLM 能通过上下文学习（ICL）遵循给定规则，却也会偏离所给证据，产生上下文外（OOC）幻觉；已有工作通常把这两者分开研究，因而难以解释这种看似相反的结果。论文把两者统一到「动态上下文中的功能角色」视角下，指出角色信息可以在模型内部被表征，却未必可靠地约束输出；作者用一阶分解刻画角色效应，说明其显著影响依赖两个必要条件——贡献幅度足够大、符号聚合一致。因果分析显示，角色片段（role span）的贡献会影响响应结构、内容选择与事实取值等关键 token 决策，而这些决策能否与角色保持一致，取决于关键位置是否有足够的角色片段支持，支持不足时错误选择可被逆转。该工作为 ICL 与幻觉提供了共同的机制解释：每种功能角色定义了输出决策的模式，角色片段贡献必须在该模式上持续有效，组织方式的差异导致两种相反结果。
arxiv.reason: 机制可解释性拆解 ICL 与幻觉，属 LLM 方向扎实分析工作

arxiv.title: Can you make models believe false facts in the prompt?
arxiv.abstract: Making LLMs believe false facts is useful for alignment evaluations and for building model organisms. Previous work explored doing so with Synthetic Document Finetuning (SDF). But SDF requires fine-tuning one new model for each set of injected false beliefs. To enable larger scale SDF-powered alignment evaluations, we attempt to produce a single model that believes any fact placed in a <facts> tag in the prompt. To do so, we explore doing prompt-conditioned SDF: fine-tuning a model on synthetic documents covering thousands of facts, with each document conditioned on a fact presented in the prompt. We evaluate how deeply the model believes the facts provided in the prompt using evaluations from prior work and a new Jacobian lens evaluation. We find that the belief depth on unseen facts scales roughly log-linearly with the number of training facts, making this a cheap, promising avenue for making models believe false facts, though preliminary experiments on applying it to alignment audits on the small model we studied showed negative results due to these small models often already acting as if they believed facts provided in regular honeypot system prompts. Using RL to reduce the rate at which models verbalize following a false fact in the prompt, on top of prompt-conditioned SDF, generalizes to held-out evals and almost matches SDF on some evaluations. But training against one of our metrics for belief depth makes it harder to trust those evaluations.
arxiv.titleZh: 能否让模型相信提示中的虚假事实?
arxiv.summaryZh: 让 LLM 相信提示中的虚假事实可用于对齐评估与构建 model organisms，已有 Synthetic Document Finetuning(SDF)需为每组注入信念单独微调一个模型。为此探索 prompt-conditioned SDF:在覆盖数千条事实的合成文档上微调单一模型，每篇文档以提示中<facts>标签给出的事实为条件。用前人评估与新的 Jacobian lens 评估信念深度，发现未见事实上的信念深度随训练事实数大致呈对数线性增长;在该小模型上的对齐审计初步实验为负结果，叠加 RL 降低模型复述虚假事实的比例可泛化到留出评估。
arxiv.reason: 虚假信念注入与对齐评估，属后训练与可解释评估方向

arxiv.title: Learning through Discernment: when a small language model learns from user feedback on the job, and when it decays
arxiv.abstract: Small language models on devices could keep improving by learning, overnight, from their own daily work. Without a true outcome, however, something must decide which attempts are worth learning from, and both the model's own judgment and the user's reaction can be wrong. We study a small model (Qwen3 0.6B and 1.7B) with a LoRA adapter, fine-tuned each night on the attempts a judge accepts, over 127 lives of up to a year on WebShop and $τ^2$-bench. We compare the true outcome, the user's stated verdict and the model's own judgment with a separate, frozen "feedback sense" that reads the user's reaction, built in three versions. Judging itself, the model improved and then decayed, over a year and whatever its adapter. A sense that took polite give-ups for success collapsed 3 of 5 lives; one built for discernment, which first asks whether the user gave a clear verdict, kept 4 of 5 near the oracle for two weeks, then faded on clean but scarce lessons, to the level of self-judging by day 60. When the user cannot see the outcome ($τ^2$-bench), the sense read reactions correctly, yet 80% of its lessons were failures the customer had thanked. Across 97 lives, the share of failed attempts among the lessons predicted the outcome (Spearman $ρ$ = -0.81). In our experiments, learning from users held up only where the judge kept failures out and the user could see the outcome; lopsided lessons may also narrow the model.
arxiv.titleZh: 在辨别中学习：小语言模型何时能在工作中从用户反馈里学到东西，何时会退化
arxiv.summaryZh: 设备端小模型想靠夜间学习从日常工作中持续变强，但在没有真实结果时，它必须判断哪些尝试值得学，而模型自评与用户反应都可能出错。用 Qwen3 0.6B/1.7B 加 LoRA，每晚在被判合格的尝试上微调，在 WebShop 与 τ²-bench 上跑最长一年、共 127 次“生命”，对比真实结果、用户明示评价、模型自评与冻结的反馈感知器。自评先升后衰；把礼貌放弃当成功的感知器令 3/5 次生命崩溃，而先判断用户是否给出明确评价的版本两周内 4/5 接近 oracle，但第 60 天仍退化到自评水平；用户看不到结果时，80% 被感谢的样本实为失败，失败占比可预测结局（Spearman ρ=-0.81）。从用户反馈学习只在评判器挡住失败、且用户能看到结果时成立。
arxiv.reason: 小模型在线从反馈自我改进，Agent 任务实证扎实，但偏经验研究与失效分析

arxiv.title: Evaluating Governed LLM-Driven ML Experimentation: Lifecycle, Provenance, and Failure Metrics
arxiv.abstract: Autonomous agents that run ML experiments are usually judged by the best score they reach. That score says nothing about how it was reached: whether the agent stayed within the files it was allowed to edit, whether failed trials were kept or silently dropped, and whether each keep or discard decision can be traced to its evidence. We propose evaluating such systems on their experimental process as well as their outcome, and we build a governed harness that makes this possible. A control plane, not the LLM that proposes changes, owns each trial's lifecycle, checks its edit scope, decides keep or discard, and appends one record per trial to an append-only ledger. Governance metrics such as the invalid-action rate, the repeated-bad rate and provenance completeness are computed from that ledger. Across six ML tasks, from synthetic logistic regression to language-model training, and 1,445 trials, the same contract applied unchanged. The ledger exposed failures that a task score hides: a no-memory arm in which all 120 trials failed, a benchmark adapter whose bounded proposals ran out, and a reset failure that reproducibility hashes revealed, after which the affected campaigns were rerun. In a matched counterfactual, a loop that logs only successful trials left no record of 43 of 50 trials, while the governed ledger recorded all 50. Memory ablations show that memory's effect on repeated bad proposals depends on the task. We release the ledgers of all 1,445 trials, so that every number reported for them can be recomputed.
arxiv.comment: 22 pages. Presented at the KDD 2026 Workshop on Evaluation and Trustworthiness of Agentic AI (ETAAI; non-archival). Code and trial ledgers: https://github.com/dowlingwong/autoresearch_harness (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.24174991)
arxiv.titleZh: 评估受治理的LLM驱动ML实验:生命周期、溯源与失败指标
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对自主Agent跑ML实验时只看最优分数、无法判断编辑是否越界与失败试验是否被记录的问题，构建受治理的harness:由控制面而非LLM掌管每次试验的生命周期，校验编辑范围、决定保留或丢弃，并向仅追加账本写入每次试验记录，据此计算无效动作率、重复错误率与溯源完整度。在6个ML任务(从合成逻辑回归到语言模型训练)共1445次试验上，账本暴露出任务分数掩盖的失败:无记忆组120次试验全部失败、某基准适配器的有界提议耗尽、可复现性哈希发现重置故障并触发重跑;匹配对照中仅记录成功试验的循环漏掉50次中的43次。该工作把Agent实验评估从结果扩展到过程，并开源全部账本以支持复算。
arxiv.reason: Agent实验生命周期治理与溯源评测，契合Agent与评测方向

embodied.title: $Z$-sight: Unifying Vision-Language-Action and Latent World Modeling
embodied.abstract: We introduce $Z$-sight, a unified robot foundation model that couples vision-language-action (VLA) and generative latent world modeling. Video-based world action models (WAMs) show the value of joint future-and-action generation for control, yet inherit the heavy cost of video generators. Recent latent-space policies avoid pixel generation, yet typically align intermediate features or rely on frozen target encoders, decoupling future prediction from the VLM's native feature space. $Z$-sight instead predicts the future directly in the visual token space in which its VLM perceives the present. Coupling a foresight expert and a continuous action expert with the VLM in a mixture-of-transformers, $Z$-sight jointly denoises future spatial tokens and actions at inference without pixel reconstruction or external encoders. Trained on human video and robot trajectories, $Z$-sight achieves 81.9% success on SIMPLE (+9.6 points over the strongest baseline) and 73.3% across six Unitree G1 tasks (+20.0 points) at 110 ms per chunk, while remaining competitive on tabletop benchmarks.
embodied.titleZh: Z-sight：统一视觉-语言-动作与潜在世界建模
embodied.summaryZh: 视频式世界-动作模型能联合生成未来与动作，却要承担视频生成器的高昂开销；现有潜在空间策略多依赖特征对齐或冻结目标编码器，使未来预测与 VLM 原生特征空间脱节。Z-sight 直接在 VLM 感知当前画面的视觉 token 空间中预测未来，用 mixture-of-transformers 将前瞻专家、连续动作专家与 VLM 耦合，推理时联合去噪未来空间 token 与动作，无需像素重建或外部编码器。在人类视频与机器人轨迹上训练后，SIMPLE 成功率达 81.9%（较最强基线 +9.6），Unitree G1 六项任务平均 73.3%（+20.0），每 chunk 仅 110 ms，桌面基准上同样具备竞争力。
embodied.reason: VLA 与潜在世界模型在 VLM token 空间统一，真机增益显著

embodied.title: Phoenix: Learning Scene Structure Representations for Generalizable World-Action Models
embodied.abstract: World-action models jointly predict future observations and actions, yet reconstruction-oriented visual representations do not explicitly emphasize the spatial relationships and object-state changes needed for manipulation. We introduce Phoenix, which learns representations of scene structure for world-action modeling. Specifically, Phoenix Encoder enriches DINOv3's general visual semantics through dual-teacher distillation of geometric and spatiotemporal semantic knowledge. Next, CS-VAE causally aggregates and compresses Phoenix Encoder features into generative latents while preserving scene information and spatial layout. Finally, Phoenix jointly predicts these latents, complementary appearance latents, and robot actions, linking scene evolution with action generation. To study pretraining data efficiency, we curate approximately 39,000 hours of egocentric and robot manipulation data for representation learning and use the robot demonstration subset for WAM pretraining. Following benchmark-specific post-training, Phoenix achieves state-of-the-art performance across simulation and real-robot benchmarks spanning single-arm, bimanual, and dexterous manipulation. It demonstrates strong robustness to perturbations, achieving success rates of 94.8% on LIBERO-Plus and 72.4% on RoboTwin 2.0 C2R, alongside strong cross-embodiment transfer and real-world manipulation performance on Bench2Dex and RoboDojo-RealWorld, respectively. Pretraining-scale analysis shows larger performance gains from data scaling than a video-VAE-only baseline, indicating stronger scaling benefits and more effective data utilization. Moreover, Phoenix maintains high success rates when adapted with limited downstream demonstrations, demonstrating strong few-shot adaptation. Our code, pretraining data, and models are available on the project page to help the community reproduce our results.
embodied.titleZh: Phoenix：学习场景结构表征以实现可泛化的世界-动作模型
embodied.summaryZh: 针对重建导向的视觉表征不显式建模操作所需的空间关系与物体状态变化这一问题，Phoenix 以场景结构表征为核心构建世界-动作模型：Phoenix Encoder 通过几何与时空语义的双教师蒸馏增强 DINOv3 的通用视觉语义，CS-VAE 对特征做因果聚合与压缩，在保留场景信息与空间布局的同时得到生成式潜变量，再联合预测该潜变量、外观潜变量与机器人动作，将场景演化与动作生成相联结。作者整理了约 39000 小时第一视角与机器人操作数据用于表征学习，并在仿真与真机的单臂、双臂、灵巧操作基准上取得 SOTA，LIBERO-Plus 成功率 94.8%、RoboTwin 2.0 C2R 72.4%，并展现出跨本体迁移、少样本适配与优于纯视频 VAE 基线的数据缩放收益。
embodied.reason: VLA/世界-动作模型核心方向，规模化预训练与多基准 SOTA

embodied.title: HINT-WAM: Hindsight-Informed Training for World Action Models
embodied.abstract: World action models (WAMs) have shown promising generalization and data efficiency in robot manipulation by coupling action generation with predictions of future visual dynamics. Translating these capabilities into reliable task execution, however, remains a challenge for existing post-training methods. Offline supervised fine-tuning provides dense supervision on expert trajectories, but its flow-matching action expert is trained only on noised demonstration actions and never on the intermediate states produced by its own sampler; task-specific adaptation can also compromise pretrained capabilities. On-policy reinforcement learning trains on the policy's own behavior, yet sparse task rewards make exploration and credit assignment difficult, while dense reward shaping still provides scalar evaluations rather than direct action targets. We introduce \textbf{HINT-WAM}, the first on-policy self-distillation framework that supervises the action expert on its own sampling trajectories using hindsight, the future video of the demonstration, as privileged information available to the WAM itself. For each demonstration observation, the student generates its action through its own denoising trajectory, and at the states along this trajectory the same model acts as a teacher conditioned additionally on this hindsight, providing a conditional action distribution as a dense training target, while the student sees only deployment-time inputs and needs no environmental rewards or simulator interaction. To transfer this supervision to a flow-matching action expert, HINT-WAM distills the teacher into the student with an energy score, a distribution-level objective that matches the teacher's action distribution from the student's own samples rather than regressing its velocity field. The project web is available in https://tuandattt.github.io/hintwam/.
embodied.titleZh: HINT-WAM:面向世界动作模型的后见信息知情训练
embodied.summaryZh: 世界动作模型(WAM)在机器人操作上泛化好、数据效率高，但后训练阶段难以把这种能力转化为可靠的任务执行:离线监督微调只在与噪声混合的专家动作上训练 flow-matching 动作专家，从未见过自身采样器产生的中间状态，且任务适配会损害预训练能力;on-policy RL 虽在自身行为上训练，却受稀疏任务奖励困扰，稠密奖励塑形也只给标量评价而非动作目标。HINT-WAM 是首个 on-policy 自蒸馏框架，把演示的未来视频作为模型自身可用的后见特权信息:学生在自身去噪轨迹的每个状态上，由同一模型以该后见为额外条件充当教师，给出条件动作分布作为稠密训练目标，学生仅见部署时输入，无需环境奖励或仿真交互。为把该监督迁移到 flow-matching 动作专家，方法以 energy score 这一分布级目标，从学生自身样本匹配教师的动作分布，而非回归其速度场。
embodied.reason: WAM 后训练新范式，后见特权信息自蒸馏，直击高分方向

embodied.title: Grana: Compositional Reward Modeling for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation
embodied.abstract: Robot reward modeling faces two challenges: generalizing across tasks and accurately tracking progress in long-horizon manipulation. General-purpose reward models demonstrate broad task transfer, but transfer from short-task pretraining to long-horizon tasks remains underexplored. Long-horizon progress models often rely on task-specific subtask classifiers or fixed action vocabularies, limiting the reuse of learned progress knowledge when adapting to new tasks. To address these challenges, we introduce Grana, a vision-language robot reward model that learns to identify unfinished subtasks and estimate their continuous progress using open-vocabulary subtask descriptions. We train a language-conditioned model to estimate progress in short-horizon tasks and individual subtasks of long-horizon tasks. For long-horizon tasks, we combine the selected subtask's predicted progress with credit for preceding completed subtasks to estimate whole-task progress. General progress prediction requires training the model across diverse tasks with progress supervision that accounts for imperfect execution. Elapsed-time proxies can misrepresent progress when relative subtask durations vary, or failures reverse local progress. We therefore introduce an annotation protocol that converts sparse subtask boundaries and action-quality annotations into dense progress targets, without requiring annotators to assign numerical progress scores. Pretraining with this supervision on 200 diverse, mostly short-horizon manipulation tasks enables zero-shot reward prediction on unseen tasks and improves progress prediction after adaptation to multi-minute, long-horizon tasks. Experiments demonstrate (i) generalizable reward prediction, including adaptation to five long-horizon tasks, (ii) benefits from pretraining and composing subtask progress estimates, and (iii) improved downstream policy performance.
embodied.titleZh: Grana:面向长程机器人操作的组合式奖励建模
embodied.summaryZh: 通用奖励模型从短程任务迁移到长程操作时进度跟踪不准，而现有长程进度模型依赖任务特定的子任务分类器或固定动作词表，学到的进度知识难以复用。Grana 用开放词汇的子任务描述让视觉-语言模型识别未完成子任务并估计其连续进度，再把所选子任务的进度与前序已完成子任务的信用组合成整任务进度。为获得训练监督，引入标注协议，将稀疏的子任务边界与动作质量标注转换为稠密进度目标，无需标注者打数值分，并在200个以短程为主的操作任务上预训练。实验显示模型可零样本给出未见任务的奖励，适配五个多分钟级长程任务后进度预测进一步提升，并改善下游策略性能。
embodied.reason: 通用奖励建模与长程进度组合，直接服务具身策略的 RL 后训练

embodied.title: Render the Robot, Generate the World: One Video World Model Across Embodiments
embodied.abstract: Predicting the consequences of an agent's actions requires modeling both the body's motion and the environment's response. Most video world models attempt to learn both from numerical actions, even though geometry and kinematics already specify the intended motion. We introduce Doppel, an embodiment-agnostic video world model conditioned on camera-aligned renderings of future body configurations and numerical action trajectories. By explicitly providing the intended motion, Doppel can focus on predicting object motion and interaction-driven changes in the environment. Rendered motion also provides a common visual interface across different embodiments and action spaces. To train on robot datasets without camera extrinsics, we recover camera poses and align rendered trajectories with recorded observations. We jointly train a single shared video backbone and conditioning adapter on eight datasets spanning eight robot and human embodiments, from single- and bimanual robot arms to a dexterous humanoid and human hands and bodies, using about 600 hours of video without embodiment labels. Across three robot-arm datasets, Doppel improves PSNR over action-only baselines by 1.00 dB on held-out trajectories and 1.20 dB under out-of-distribution evaluation, while predicting more consistent object motion. Training on all eight embodiments (Doppel-8) improves robot predictions over the three-robot model (Doppel-3) on four of six evaluation sets. Project page: https://doppelwm.github.io/.
embodied.titleZh: 渲染机器人，生成世界:一个跨本体的视频世界模型
embodied.summaryZh: 视频世界模型通常只从数值动作推断身体运动与环境响应，忽略了已知的几何与运动学信息。Doppel 以相机对齐的未来身体构型渲染图加数值动作轨迹为条件，显式给出意图运动，使模型专注预测物体运动与交互引起的变化，渲染图同时充当跨本体的统一视觉接口。为利用无相机外参的机器人数据，先恢复相机位姿并对齐渲染轨迹，再联合训练共享视频骨干与条件适配器，覆盖 8 种机器人/人类本体、约 600 小时视频且不使用本体标签。三个机械臂数据集上，PSNR 较仅用动作的基线在留出轨迹提升 1.00 dB、分布外提升 1.20 dB，八本体模型在 6 个评测集中的 4 个优于三本体模型。
embodied.reason: 跨本体视频世界模型，渲染条件机制新颖且规模扎实

embodied.title: DiWALI: Diffusion Policy Learning in World Models via Latent Action Inference from Human and Robot Play
embodied.abstract: Learning robot manipulation is constrained by the availability of action-labeled robot data, for both imitation and world models. Humans can demonstrate skills in seconds, but their demonstrations lack the required robot actions. We introduce DiWALI, a framework that learns and improves diffusion policies within a world model trained on human and robot play. DiWALI infers latent actions from consecutive frames using an inverse dynamics model, enabling world model training without action labels, and grounds them in robot commands through a decoder trained separately on robot play. Skill policies are trained over latent actions from action-free human demonstrations and improved with reinforcement learning in imagination. On the CALVIN benchmark, DiWALI policies trained solely from human demonstrations substantially outperform baselines trained with robot demonstrations. Incorporating human play into the world model training also yields stronger policies after fine-tuning than using the same amount of robot play alone. Experiments on a physical robot show that skills learned primarily from human demonstrations are further improved in imagination with a world model trained on human and robot play. Together, these results demonstrate that human experience can support both manipulation skill acquisition and subsequent policy improvement, reducing reliance on action-labeled robot data. Videos, dataset and code are available at https://diwali.cs.uni-freiburg.de.
embodied.titleZh: DiWALI:通过从人类与机器人游玩数据中推断潜在动作，在世界模型中进行扩散策略学习
embodied.summaryZh: 机器人操作学习受限于带动作标注的机器人数据，人类演示易得却缺少机器人动作。DiWALI 用逆动力学模型从相邻帧推断潜在动作，使世界模型能在无动作标签的人类与机器人游玩数据上训练，并用单独在机器人数据上训练的解码器把潜在动作对齐到机器人指令;技能策略在无动作人类演示的潜在动作空间上训练，再在世界模型的想象中通过强化学习改进。CALVIN 上仅用人类演示训练的策略显著优于用机器人演示训练的基线，世界模型混入人类游玩数据后微调也强于等量机器人数据;真机实验显示技能可在想象中进一步提升。这表明人类经验能同时支撑技能获取与后续策略改进，降低对动作标注机器人数据的依赖。
embodied.reason: 世界模型加人类视频潜在动作推断，命中具身高分方向

embodied.title: RoboMorpher: Scaling Robot Morphology Representations for Cross-Embodiment Action Prediction
embodied.abstract: Learning shared action representations is central to cross-embodiment manipulation. However, identical joint values can produce different spatial configurations across robots, limiting representations learned from joint values alone. We introduce RoboMorpher, a morphology-conditioned action tokenizer that jointly reconstructs joint angles and link poses to associate control coordinates with their kinematic effects. MorphGen supplies scalable kinematic supervision by generating serial-arm descriptions from survey-derived geometric priors. We pretrain RoboMorpher on 40 million morphology-state pairs and integrate the frozen tokenizer into a vision-language-action policy for discrete prediction and continuous refinement. We also introduce EmbodiBench, a ten-task benchmark with 30 generated URDFs per task. With downstream URDFs excluded from tokenizer pretraining, the policy achieves 56.40% success on RoboTwin 2.0 and 23.27% on EmbodiBench, exceeding continuous joint-space control by 9.73 and 15.34 percentage points. Removing link-pose supervision reduces EmbodiBench success by 17.94 percentage points, supporting morphology-aware geometric supervision for joint-action representation learning.
embodied.titleZh: RoboMorpher：扩展机器人形态表示以实现跨本体动作预测
embodied.summaryZh: 跨本体操作需要共享动作表示，但相同关节值在不同机器人上对应不同空间构型，仅靠关节值学到的表示受限。RoboMorpher是形态条件动作tokenizer，联合重建关节角与连杆位姿，把控制坐标与其运动学效应绑定;MorphGen依据调研得到的几何先验生成串联臂描述，提供可扩展的运动学监督。在4000万形态-状态对上预训练后，冻结的tokenizer接入VLA策略做离散预测与连续精修。在RoboTwin 2.0与新建的EmbodiBench(10任务，每任务30个生成URDF)上成功率分别为56.40%与23.27%，比连续关节空间控制高9.73与15.34个百分点;去掉连杆位姿监督后EmbodiBench下降17.94个百分点。
embodied.reason: 跨本体动作表示与VLA策略结合，方法新颖、实验扎实

embodied.title: F$^3$: What Makes Good Experience in World-Action Models?
embodied.abstract: Deployed world-action models (WAMs) can keep improving only if they make good use of their own experience. Existing methods supply retrieved rollouts or demonstrations to the policy as context, yet such experience often turns previously solved tasks into failures. What, then, makes good experience for a WAM? We show that experience is valuable only in use: its value depends not on whether the source rollout succeeded but on what is stored, when it is used, and where it enters the policy. We therefore propose F$^3$, which makes these three decisions with Form, Fit, and Fusion. Form compresses successful and failed rollouts alike into short, verified operation records; Fit teaches the policy to read a record and to predict when it helps; Fusion injects the record's images, text and actions into the policy as a prefix and an action prior. Trained once on only 200 examples and deployed with a growing experience library, the model achieves state-of-the-art results on MolmoSpaces and RoboLab without any training on RoboLab: over native Cosmos 3 Nano, it raises success by 12.0 pp and 10.8 pp, reduces steps to success by 12.2% and 11.3%, and cuts regressions by 57%.
embodied.titleZh: F$^3$:世界-动作模型中什么样的经验才算好经验?
embodied.summaryZh: 世界-动作模型(WAM)部署后要靠自身经验持续提升，但把检索到的历史轨迹当作上下文常常让已解决的任务重新失败。F$^3$ 主张经验的价值取决于存什么、何时用、用在哪:Form 把成功与失败的 rollout 统一压缩为简短且经校验的操作记录，Fit 训练策略读取记录并预测它是否有帮助，Fusion 将记录中的图像、文本与动作以前缀和动作先验注入策略。仅用200条样本训练一次并配合持续增长的经验库，在 MolmoSpaces 与 RoboLab 上取得 SOTA，未在 RoboLab 训练即比原生 Cosmos 3 Nano 成功率提升12.0pp与10.8pp，回退减少57%。
embodied.reason: WAM 经验利用机制新颖、实验扎实，直接命中世界-动作模型方向

embodied.title: SHAPE: Discrete Supervision and Parallel Continuous Streams for Learning Dexterous Manipulation from Egocentric Human Data
embodied.abstract: Egocentric human recordings are far cheaper than dexterous robot demonstrations, promising stronger pretraining and direct skill learning without task-specific robot data. Yet humans and robots differ in morphology and kinematics, so human recordings lack the joint positions and actuator commands that supervise robot policies, providing only retargeted end-effector (EEF) actions. This raises two questions: how human data should supervise the policy, and how a dexterous robot should read out actions at deployment. We address both in SHAPE (Supervision from Human Action tokens with Parallel Executable streams), a vision-language-action (VLA) model whose backbone predicts discrete action tokens of EEF chunks as an auxiliary task, while a shared flow-matching expert outputs two executable streams, EEF and joint. On a bimanual robot with 22-DoF hands, a matched study shows that discrete supervision helps learn from human data, driving backbone gradients and shaping action-informative representations across domains. Under standard control pipelines at deployment, direct joint readout excels at fine-grained control with robot demonstrations, scoring 0.80 across six tasks against 0.63 for π0.5, whereas IK-based EEF readout excels at human-to-robot transfer. Pretrained with human data and discrete tokens, SHAPE learns new tasks from human demonstrations without task-specific robot data.
embodied.titleZh: SHAPE：离散监督与并行连续流，从第一视角人类数据学习灵巧操作
embodied.summaryZh: 第一视角人类视频远比机器人示教便宜，但缺少关节位置与执行器指令，只能提供重定向后的末端执行器动作，由此带来两个问题:人类数据如何监督策略、灵巧机器人部署时如何读出动作。SHAPE 是一个 VLA 模型:主干网络以预测末端执行器动作块的离散 token 为辅助任务，共享的 flow-matching 专家同时输出末端执行器与关节两条可执行流。在配备 22 自由度双手的机器人上，匹配实验显示离散监督能驱动主干梯度、塑造跨域的动作信息表征;部署时直接关节读出在六项任务上得 0.80，高于 π0.5 的 0.63，而基于 IK 的末端执行器读出更利于人到机器人的迁移。仅用人类数据与离散 token 预训练，即可在没有任务专用机器人数据的情况下学习新任务。
embodied.reason: VLA 架构与人类数据监督机制新颖，含与 π0.5 的对照实验

embodied.title: Towards Pose-Robust Few-Shot Vision-Language-Action Models
embodied.abstract: Fine-tuning a vision-language-action (VLA) model on a few dozen demonstrations is the standard way to put a manipulation policy on a robot, yet the resulting policy silently assumes that the camera and the robot base stay exactly where they were during data collection: a bumped tripod or a base re-docked a few centimetres away makes it reach for the wrong place. We show that both failures are one phenomenon, a change of the camera-to-base extrinsic that the policy has memorised, and that the robot carries everything needed to undo it. We introduce WACO, a world-anchored canonicalization framework for VLA models: the arm, placed by forward kinematics at the measured joint angles, serves as a metric calibration target, and the static scene serves as the world anchor that tells a moved camera from a moved robot. From a single RGB-D frame, WACO estimates both shifts without ground-truth extrinsics or extra data, canonicalises the image to the calibration viewpoint and the state, action and start pose to the calibration base frame, and fine-tunes the unmodified policy under the artefacts of its own estimator. We also introduce LIBERO-PoseShift, the first benchmark for RGB VLAs with graded camera, base and compound shifts. Across LIBERO-PoseShift, the LIBERO-Plus camera track and four real-world tasks on a UR5e robot, WACO consistently outperforms the standard few-shot recipe and prior viewpoint-robust methods, raising shifted success by 13.2 points in simulation and by 36.7 points on the real robot, recovering 90% of the simulation gap to a ground-truth oracle and 87% of the real-robot gap, and establishing a new state of the art among methods that use no perturbed training data, with no test-time calibration. Project page: https://peacelwh.github.io/WACO/.
embodied.comment: 17 pages, 13 figures, 17 tables (including supplementary material). Project page: https://peacelwh.github.io/WACO/
embodied.titleZh: 面向位姿鲁棒的少样本视觉-语言-动作模型
embodied.summaryZh: 少量示教微调的 VLA 策略默认相机与基座停在采数时的位置，三脚架被碰或基座重新对接几厘米就会抓错地方。WACO 把相机-基座外参变化视为单一失效源:用正运动学把机械臂当作公制标定靶、以静态场景为世界锚点区分相机移动与机器人移动，从单帧 RGB-D 估计两者位移，将图像规范化到标定视角、状态/动作/起始位姿规范化到标定基座系，并在自身估计误差下微调原策略。同时发布分级位姿偏移基准 LIBERO-PoseShift，仿真偏移成功率提升 13.2 点、UR5e 真机提升 36.7 点，分别弥补 90% 与 87% 相对真值 oracle 的差距，且无需扰动训练数据与测试时标定。
